1748const PM_ORDINAL_SUFFICES: &[&str] = &["th", "st", "nd", "rd", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th"];
1749const FNSYMBOLS: &[&str] = &[
1750  "*",
1751  "\u{2020}",
1752  "\u{2021}",
1753  "\u{00A7}",
1754  "\u{00B6}",
1755  "\u{2225}",
1756  "**",
1757  "\u{2020}\u{2020}",
1758  "\u{2021}\u{2021}",
1759];
1760
1761//**********************************************************************
1762// C.6 Displayed Paragraphs
1763//**********************************************************************
1764/// Perl: setupAligningContext — saves [node, lastChild] for deferred class application.
1765///
1766/// Local scope, like Perl: a nested context (`\centering` in a minipage
1767/// panel inside a centered figure) restores the outer one when the panel's
1768/// collected frame pops at build time (tests/graphics/graphrot). Under
1769/// streaming the build step runs inside `state::with_build_floor`, which keeps
1770/// a base-level binding from popping with a DIGESTION group instead.
1771fn setup_aligning_context(doc: &mut Document) {
1772  if let Some(node) = doc.get_element() {
1773    // Save node and its current last child so we only apply to NEW children later
1774    assign_value("ALIGNING_NODE", Stored::Node(node.clone()), None);
1775    match node.get_last_child() {
1776      Some(last) => {
1777        assign_value("ALIGNING_PREV_CHILD", Stored::Node(last), None);
1778      },
1779      _ => {
1780        assign_value("ALIGNING_PREV_CHILD", Stored::None, None);
1781      },
1782    }
1783  }
1784}
1785/// Perl: applyAligningContext — applies align/class to children added AFTER \centering.
1786fn apply_aligning_context(document: &mut Document, align: &str, class: &str) -> Result<()> {
1787  // with_value avoids two Stored envelope clones; Node is Rc-backed so we
1788  // still pay a Rc::clone inside the closure but skip the enum match work.
1789  let node_opt = with_value("ALIGNING_NODE", |v| match v {
1790    Some(Stored::Node(node)) => Some(node.clone()),
1791    _ => None,
1792  });
1793  if let Some(mut node) = node_opt.clone()
1794    && is_heading_name(document::get_node_qname(&node))
1795  {
1796    // A heading is one paragraph, and TeX's `\centering`/`\raggedright`/`\raggedleft` set
1797    // `\leftskip`/`\rightskip`/`\parfillskip` for the paragraph they end (latex.ltx:15409-15423):
1798    // the heading's own, whichever of its inline children follow the switch. Perl sets it on those
1799    // children (latex_constructs.pool.ltxml:1225-1235) — an `align` on a title's inline `<text>`
1800    // that centres nothing and blocks the font collapsing onto the title, so a size in the format
1801    // multiplies with the title's own (a titlesec `{\huge\bfseries\filcenter}` chapter at ≈517%).
1802    // Centring is the text alignment only (`ltx_align_center`): `ltx_centering` is a centred block,
1803    // which would stop a run-in heading running in. OXIDIZED_DESIGN_DIVERGENCES #344.
1804    let class = if class == "ltx_centering" {
1805      "ltx_align_center"
1806    } else {
1807      class
1808    };
1809    set_align_or_class(document, &mut node, align, class)?;
1810  } else if let Some(node) = node_opt {
1811    let previous_opt = with_value("ALIGNING_PREV_CHILD", |v| match v {
1812      Some(Stored::Node(prev)) => Some(prev.clone()),
1813      _ => None,
1814    });
1815    let children = node.get_child_nodes();
1816    let mut past_previous = previous_opt.is_none(); // if no previous, apply to all
1817    for mut child in children {
1818      if !past_previous {
1819        if let Some(ref prev) = previous_opt
1820          && child == *prev
1821        {
1822          past_previous = true;
1823        }
1824        continue;
1825      }
1826      if child.get_type() == Some(NodeType::ElementNode) {
1827        set_align_or_class(document, &mut child, align, class)?;
1828      }
1829    }
1830  }
1831  // Release the saved node handles: every `assign_value` here PUSHES onto the
1832  // key's binding stack (build-time assignments sit outside digestion groups,
1833  // so nothing ever pops them — under streaming `state::with_build_floor`
1834  // restores that invariant), and each retained `Stored::Node` pins its
1835  // whole document — under streaming, a pinned handle into a SPILLED subtree
1836  // even blocks the `xmlFreeNode` the spill relies on. Overwrite with `None`
1837  // so the C trees can go; the (empty) stack entries themselves are the cheap
1838  // part (dhat: 288 B each).
1839  assign_value("ALIGNING_NODE", Stored::None, None);
1840  assign_value("ALIGNING_PREV_CHILD", Stored::None, None);
1841  Ok(())
1842}
1843
1844/// A heading element: its content is the one paragraph an alignment switch inside it sets.
1845fn is_heading_name(qname: SymStr) -> bool {
1846  qname == pin!("ltx:title") || qname == pin!("ltx:toctitle") || qname == pin!("ltx:subtitle")
1847}
1848
1849/// Real LaTeX's `\verb`/`{verbatim}` do `\let\do\@makeother\dospecials`:
1850/// every char REGISTERED in `\dospecials` — including chars packages like
1851/// csquotes/babel/underscore made ACTIVE and added exactly so verbatim
1852/// neutralizes them (csquotes.sty L1521-1524) — becomes catcode OTHER.
1853/// LaTeXML's static SPECIALS list misses those dynamic registrations, so an
1854/// active auto-quote char inside a `\verb` body FIRED its csquotes meaning
1855/// (biblatex.tex L6575 `\verb|<|` → `\csq@qopen` → sfcodes probe + a
1856/// truncated `\csq@fixkern` \expandafter chain; 94 errors; Perl shares —
1857/// pdflatex clean). Expand `\dospecials` and de-fang each listed char.
1858fn apply_dospecials() {
1859  // ONE-level expansion: the list body is `\do \<char>` pairs; full
1860  // expansion would invoke `\do` itself with whatever meaning it holds.
1861  let expansion = match lookup_expandable(&T_CS!("\\dospecials"), None) {
1862    Ok(Some(defn)) => defn.invoke(true),
1863    _ => return,
1864  };
1865  if let Ok(expansion) = expansion {
1866    for t in expansion.unlist_ref().iter() {
1867      if !t.get_catcode().is_active_or_cs() {
1868        continue;
1869      }
1870      // The list alternates `\do` and single-char tokens (`\do\ \do\\…`);
1871      // chars appear as single-char CS or ACTIVE tokens.
1872      t.with_cs_name(|name| {
1873        // The stored CS text keeps its leading escape char (`\<` → "\\<").
1874        let name = name.strip_prefix('\\').unwrap_or(name);
1875        let mut chars = name.chars();
1876        if let Some(c) = chars.next()
1877          && chars.next().is_none()
1878        {
1879          assign_catcode(c, Catcode::OTHER, Some(Scope::Local));
1880        }
1881      });
1882    }
1883  }
1884}
1885
1886fn before_digest_verbatim() -> Result<Vec<Digested>> {
1887  bgroup();
1888  apply_dospecials();
1889  let mut stuff = Vec::new();
1890  if let Some(b) = lookup_tokens("@environment@verbatim@atbegin") {
1891    stuff.push(digest(b.unlist())?);
1892  }
1893  AssignValue!("current_environment", "verbatim");
1894  DefMacro!("\\@currenvir", "verbatim");
1895  MergeFont!(family => "typewriter");
1896  Ok(stuff)
1897}
1898
1899fn after_digest_verbatim(starred: bool, whatsit: &mut Whatsit) -> Result<()> {
1900  // makes you wonder if the `get_font` API should be working with Rc<Font> in the first place...
1901  let font: Option<Rc<Font>> = whatsit.get_font()?.map(|ft| Rc::new((*ft).clone()));
1902  let loc = whatsit.get_locator();
1903  let (end, space) = if starred {
1904    ("\\end{verbatim*}", '\u{2423}')
1905  } else {
1906    ("\\end{verbatim}", ' ')
1907  };
1908  // latex.ltx `\@verbatim` runs `\@noligs`, whose active `'`/`` ` `` print as it says: upquote.sty:26-37 appends
1909  // `\let'\textquotesingle` (or `\def'{\char13 }` in OT1 cmtt), upright, where the font's own are curly (issue #801).
1910  let mut upquotes: Vec<(char, String)> = Vec::new();
1911  for c in ['\'', '`'] {
1912    let typeset = Tokens::new(vec![
1913      T_CS!("\\hbox"),
1914      T_BEGIN!(),
1915      T_CS!("\\@noligs"),
1916      T_ACTIVE!(c),
1917      T_END!(),
1918    ]);
1919    let mut printed = String::new();
1920    ink_text(&digest(typeset)?, &mut printed);
1921    upquotes.push((c, printed));
1922  }
1923  let mut lines: Vec<_> = Vec::new();
1924  // The body is decoded through the document's 8-bit input encoding (inputenc's
1925  // active upper-half characters keep their meaning: latex.ltx:15441-15459
1926  // `\@verbatim` resets only `\dospecials`), as `.bib` lines are. A cp1251
1927  // listing came out as Latin-1 mojibake (russ_doc, serbian-apostrophe).
1928  // Guard: `perfect_kernel_batch56::verbatim_decodes_the_input_encoding`.
1929  while let Some(next_line) = read_raw_line_decoded() {
1930    let mut line = next_line.as_str();
1931    let mut exiting = false;
1932    if let Some((final_line, remaining)) = line.split_once(end) {
1933      line = final_line;
1934      // The rest of the `\end{verbatim}` line is re-read LAZILY, as raw
1935      // source, the way TeX does (latex.ltx:15438 `\@xverbatim` is delimited
1936      // by the catcode-12 `\end{verbatim}` string and `\end` runs `\endgroup`
1937      // BEFORE the remainder is tokenized, tex.web §332). Perl's
1938      // latex_constructs.pool:1777 (and the former port) pre-tokenized it,
1939      // which handed a `\verb` on that line frozen tokens: its reader
1940      // (`read_verb_invocation`) activates the delimiter and scans raw chars,
1941      // so the frozen `|` never matched, the scan ran off the end and
1942      // re-tokenized the rest of the DOCUMENT under `\dospecials` (ddphonism
1943      // :87 `\end{verbatim} produces the same as \verb|\dmatrix{…}|.` — every
1944      // later `{`/`}`/`\` literal, three lists never closed; Perl identical,
1945      // KPE #165). The lazy mouth supplies the line's own end-of-line.
1946      // Guard: `perfect_kernel_batch54::verb_on_the_endverbatim_line_scans_raw`.
1947      if remaining.trim().is_empty() {
1948        unread_one(T_CR!());
1949      } else {
1950        open_mouth(Mouth::new(remaining, None)?, true);
1951      }
1952      // Hand `\end{verbatim}` back to the CURRENT `\end` macro instead of
1953      // consuming it here: latex.ltx:15438 `\def\@xverbatim#1\end{verbatim}
1954      // {#1\end{verbatim}}` re-executes the terminator, so packages that hook
1955      // `\begin`/`\end` (knowledge.sty:1671-1685 pushes a scope area at
1956      // `\begin{verbatim}` and pops it at `\end{verbatim}`) stay balanced.
1957      // Perl's fused constructor (latex_constructs.pool.ltxml:1734) swallows
1958      // the terminator, but Perl never defines `\verbatim`/`\endverbatim`, so
1959      // knowledge's `\KnowledgeConfigureEnvironment?` (:3754, gated on both
1960      // existing) never registers the area there; our dumped latex.ltx does
1961      // define them. The fused `\end{verbatim}` (sect06.rs) is a no-op so the
1962      // kernel `\end` adds nothing: the group already closed below.
1963      // OXIDIZED_DESIGN_DIVERGENCES #199. Guard:
1964      // `perfect_kernel_batch56::package_state_prtec_psfragx_knowledge`.
1965      let mut end_tokens = vec![T_CS!("\\end"), T_BEGIN!()];
1966      end_tokens.extend(ExplodeText!(if starred { "verbatim*" } else { "verbatim" }));
1967      end_tokens.push(T_END!());
1968      unread_expansion(Tokens::new(end_tokens));
1969      exiting = true;
1970    }
1971    // The raw chars will still have to be decoded (but not space!!). A TAB
1972    // keeps catcode 10 under `\dospecials` (^^I is not in the list), so it is
1973    // a space in verbatim, not OT1 slot 9 `Ψ` (Perl :1773 decodes it; KPE #165).
1974    let mut decoded_line: String = String::new();
1975    for c in line.chars() {
1976      if c == ' ' || c == '\t' {
1977        decoded_line.push(space);
1978      } else if let Some((_, typeset)) = upquotes.iter().find(|(q, t)| *q == c && !t.is_empty()) {
1979        decoded_line.push_str(typeset);
1980      } else {
1981        let decoded_c = font::decode_string(pin_char(c), Some("OT1_typewriter"), true);
1982        with(decoded_c, |c_str| decoded_line.push_str(c_str));
1983      }
1984    }
1985    decoded_line.push('\n');
1986    lines.push(pin(decoded_line));
1987    if exiting {
1988      break;
1989    }
1990  }
1991  if let Some(last_line) = lines.last()
1992    && *last_line == pin!("\n")
1993  {
1994    lines.pop();
1995  }
1996  // Note last line ends up as Whatsit's "trailer"
1997  if let Some(b) = lookup_tokens("@environment@verbatim@atend") {
1998    lines.push(pin(digest(b)?.to_string()));
1999  }
2000  egroup()?;
2001  lines.push(pin_static(end));
2002  let boxes = lines
2003    .into_iter()
2004    .map(|line| {
2005      Tbox::new(
2006        line,
2007        font.clone(),
2008        loc,
2009        Token!(sym line, Catcode::OTHER).into(),
2010        SymHashMap::default(),
2011      )
2012      .into()
2013    })
2014    .collect();
2015  whatsit.set_body(boxes);
2016  Ok(())
2017}
2018
2019//======================================================================
2020// C.7.1 Math Mode Environments
2021//======================================================================
2022// # This provides {equation} with the capabilities for tags, nonumber, etc
2023// # even though stock LaTeX provides no means to override them.
2024// #   preset => boolean
2025// #   postset => boolean
2026// #   deferretract=>boolean
2027pub fn prepare_equation_counter(options: SymHashMap<Stored>) {
2028  // Guard: ensure the equation counter exists — normally created by article.cls,
2029  // but standalone classes (jpsj2, appolb, etc.) may not define it.
2030  if lookup_definition(&T_CS!("\\theequation@ID"))
2031    .ok()
2032    .flatten()
2033    .is_none()
2034  {
2035    let _ = new_counter(
2036      "equation",
2037      "section",
2038      Some(NewDefault!(NewCounterOptions, idprefix => "E")),
2039    );
2040  }
2041  assign_value(
2042    "EQUATION_NUMBERING",
2043    Stored::HashStored(options),
2044    Some(Scope::Global),
2045  );
2046}
2047pub fn before_equation() -> Result<()> {
2048  let mut has_preset = false;
2049  let mut is_numbered = false;
2050  maybe_peek_label()?;
2051  let ctr = with_value_mut("EQUATION_NUMBERING", |val_opt| {
2052    if let Some(Stored::HashStored(numbering)) = val_opt {
2053      numbering.insert("in_equation", true.into());
2054      is_numbered = matches!(numbering.get("numbered"), Some(&Stored::Bool(true)));
2055      has_preset = numbering.contains_key("preset");
2056      match numbering.get("counter") {
2057        Some(Stored::String(v)) => to_string(*v),
2058        Some(other) => {
2059          emit_warn(
2060            "internal",
2061            "state",
2062            &format!("eq counter should be stored as string, was instead: {other:?}"),
2063          );
2064          String::from("equation")
2065        },
2066        _ => String::from("equation"),
2067      }
2068    } else {
2069      String::from("equation")
2070    }
2071  });
2072  if has_preset {
2073    let mut tags = if is_numbered {
2074      ref_step_counter_by_meaning(&ctr)?
2075    } else {
2076      ref_step_id(&ctr)?
2077    };
2078    tags.insert("preset", true.into());
2079    assign_value("EQUATIONROW_TAGS", tags, Some(Scope::Global));
2080  } else {
2081    assign_value(
2082      "EQUATIONROW_TAGS",
2083      Stored::HashStored(SymHashMap::default()),
2084      Some(Scope::Global),
2085    );
2086  }
2087  let_i(
2088    &T_CS!("\\lx@end@display@math"),
2089    &T_CS!("\\lx@eDM@in@equation"),
2090    None,
2091  );
2092  let_i(
2093    &T_CS!("\\lx@begin@display@math"),
2094    &T_CS!("\\lx@bDM@in@equation"),
2095    None,
2096  );
2097  Ok(())
2098}
2099pub fn after_equation(whatsit: Option<&mut Whatsit>) -> Result<()> {
2100  // Phase 1: Gather all needed data from state (immutable borrows only)
2101  enum EqAction {
2102    Retract,
2103    Postset,
2104    TagsUpdate,
2105    None,
2106  }
2107  let mut action = EqAction::None;
2108  let mut is_aligned = false;
2109  let mut is_numbered_for_postset = false;
2110  let mut ctr = String::from("equation");
2111  with_value("EQUATION_NUMBERING", |eq_num_opt| {
2112    if let Some(Stored::HashStored(numbering)) = eq_num_opt {
2113      is_aligned = matches!(numbering.get("aligned"), Some(&Stored::Bool(true)));
2114      is_numbered_for_postset = matches!(numbering.get("numbered"), Some(&Stored::Bool(true)));
2115      with_value("EQUATIONROW_TAGS", |tags_opt| {
2116        if let Some(Stored::HashStored(tags)) = tags_opt {
2117          ctr = tags
2118            .get("counter")
2119            .map_or_else(|| numbering.get("counter"), Some)
2120            .map(ToString::to_string)
2121            .unwrap_or_else(|| String::from("equation"));
2122          if !matches!(tags.get("noretract"), Some(&Stored::Bool(true)))
2123            && (matches!(tags.get("retract"), Some(&Stored::Bool(true)))
2124              || (matches!(numbering.get("retract"), Some(&Stored::Bool(true)))
2125                && matches!(numbering.get("preset"), Some(&Stored::Bool(true)))
2126                && matches!(tags.get("preset"), Some(&Stored::Bool(true)))))
2127          {
2128            action = EqAction::Retract;
2129          } else if matches!(numbering.get("postset"), Some(&Stored::Bool(true)))
2130            && !matches!(tags.get("reset"), Some(&Stored::Bool(true)))
2131          {
2132            action = EqAction::Postset;
2133          } else if !matches!(tags.get("reset"), Some(&Stored::Bool(true)))
2134            && matches!(numbering.get("numbered"), Some(&Stored::Bool(true)))
2135          {
2136            action = EqAction::TagsUpdate;
2137          }
2138        }
2139      });
2140    }
2141  });
2142  // Phase 2: Act on gathered data (borrows released, safe to mutate state)
2143  match action {
2144    EqAction::Retract => {
2145      retract_equation();
2146    },
2147    EqAction::Postset => {
2148      let new_tags = if is_numbered_for_postset {
2149        ref_step_counter_by_meaning(&ctr)?
2150      } else {
2151        ref_step_id(&ctr)?
2152      };
2153      assign_value(
2154        "EQUATIONROW_TAGS",
2155        Stored::HashStored(new_tags),
2156        Some(Scope::Global),
2157      );
2158    },
2159    EqAction::TagsUpdate => {
2160      let invoked_tags = build_invocation(T_CS!("\\lx@make@tags"), vec![Some(Tokens::new(
2161        Explode!(ctr),
2162      ))])?;
2163      let stored_tags_update = Stored::Digested(digest(invoked_tags)?);
2164      with_value_mut("EQUATIONROW_TAGS", |tags_opt| {
2165        if let Some(Stored::HashStored(tags)) = tags_opt {
2166          tags.insert("tags", stored_tags_update);
2167        }
2168      });
2169    },
2170    EqAction::None => {},
2171  }
2172  // Phase 3: Reset in_equation flag
2173  with_value_mut("EQUATION_NUMBERING", |eq_num_opt| {
2174    if let Some(Stored::HashStored(numbering)) = eq_num_opt {
2175      numbering.insert("in_equation", Stored::Bool(false));
2176    }
2177  });
2178  // Phase 4: Install tags in $whatsit or current Row, as appropriate.
2179  #[allow(clippy::manual_unwrap_or_default)]
2180  let props = match remove_value("EQUATIONROW_TAGS") {
2181    Some(Stored::HashStored(hs)) => hs,
2182    _ => SymHashMap::default(),
2183  };
2184  if is_aligned {
2185    // Perl: propagate id/tags to current alignment row.
2186    // In Perl, these get stored as $$row{id}, $$row{tags} on the row object.
2187    // Store on the current alignment row so each row retains its own props.
2188    if let Some(alignment_digested) = lookup_alignment()
2189      && let Some(alignment_cell) = alignment_digested.alignment_cell()
2190    {
2191      let mut alignment = alignment_cell.borrow_mut();
2192      if let Some(row) = alignment.current_row_mut() {
2193        for (key, val) in &props {
2194          row.properties.insert(to_string(*key), val.clone());
2195        }
2196      }
2197    }
2198  } else if let Some(w) = whatsit {
2199    w.set_properties(props);
2200  }
2201  Ok(())
2202}
2203/// Perl: latex_constructs.pool.ltxml lines 2025-2035. Two IEEEeqnarray additions (the numbering key `subnumbers=1`),
2204/// on every path that retracts a row (its end, an immediate `\nonumber` in `IEEEeqnarray*`, a `\tag`): a row whose
2205/// pre-advance of `equation` reset a sub-equation number ([`SUBEQUATION_ROLLBACK`]) gives it back, as IEEEtrantools
2206/// steps nothing for a row it leaves unnumbered (`\IEEEnonumber`, IEEEtrantools.sty:1405; `IEEEeqnarray*`'s `e &=& f
2207/// \nonumber \\ g &=& h \IEEEyessubnumber`, pdflatex "0f", this port "0a" when the retraction dropped the key; witness
2208/// 1610.06458 `eq:inq3`, PDF 36c); and a row whose counters an `\IEEEyesnumber`/`\IEEEyessubnumber` set
2209/// ([`EQUATIONROW_HOLDS`]) keeps them, its number passed to the next row ([`EQUATIONROW_CARRY`]).
2210fn retract_equation() {
2211  // Phase 1: Gather data (immutable borrows)
2212  let (ctr, is_preset, is_numbered, rollback, holds) =
2213    with_value("EQUATION_NUMBERING", |eq_num_opt| {
2214      let numbering = match eq_num_opt {
2215        Some(Stored::HashStored(n)) => n,
2216        _ => return (String::from("equation"), false, false, None, false),
2217      };
2218      let is_numbered = matches!(numbering.get("numbered"), Some(&Stored::Bool(true)));
2219      with_value("EQUATIONROW_TAGS", |tags_opt| {
2220        let tags = match tags_opt {
2221          Some(Stored::HashStored(t)) => t,
2222          _ => return (String::from("equation"), false, is_numbered, None, false),
2223        };
2224        let ctr = tags
2225          .get("counter")
2226          .map_or_else(|| numbering.get("counter"), Some)
2227          .map(ToString::to_string)
2228          .unwrap_or_else(|| String::from("equation"));
2229        let is_preset = matches!(tags.get("preset"), Some(&Stored::Bool(true)));
2230        let rollback = match tags.get(SUBEQUATION_ROLLBACK) {
2231          Some(Stored::Int(rollback)) => Some(*rollback),
2232          _ => None,
2233        };
2234        let holds = matches!(tags.get(EQUATIONROW_HOLDS), Some(&Stored::Bool(true)));
2235        (ctr, is_preset, is_numbered, rollback, holds)
2236      })
2237    });
2238  // Phase 2: Mutate state (borrows released)
2239  if holds {
2240    // (IEEEtrantools' `\global\@IEEEeqnumpreadvfalse`, :1402, :1422: the counters are the row's number, which the
2241    // next row prints, :2086-2088; or none follows and they stay, :2022-2023)
2242    let carry = if counter_value("subequation").is_ok_and(|n| n.value_of() > 0) {
2243      "subequation"
2244    } else {
2245      "equation"
2246    };
2247    assign_value(
2248      EQUATIONROW_CARRY,
2249      Stored::String(pin(carry)),
2250      Some(Scope::Global),
2251    );
2252  } else if is_preset {
2253    // counter (or ID counter) was stepped, so decrement it.
2254    let counter_name = if is_numbered {
2255      ctr.clone()
2256    } else {
2257      s!("UN{}", ctr)
2258    };
2259    let _ = add_to_counter(&counter_name, Number::new(-1));
2260  }
2261  if let Some(rollback) = rollback
2262    && let Ok(current) = counter_value("subequation")
2263  {
2264    let _ = add_to_counter("subequation", Number::new(rollback - current.value_of()));
2265  }
2266  if let Ok(mut new_tags) = ref_step_id(&ctr) {
2267    new_tags.insert("reset", true.into());
2268    assign_value(
2269      "EQUATIONROW_TAGS",
2270      Stored::HashStored(new_tags),
2271      Some(Scope::Global),
2272    );
2273  }
2274}
2275/// Perl: latex_constructs.pool.ltxml lines 2287-2325
2276/// eqnarrayBindings — creates alignment with equationgroup/equation/_Capture_ hooks
2277pub fn eqnarray_bindings() -> Result<()> {
2278  install_eqnarray_alignment(eqnarray_columns(), 3)?;
2279  // latex.ltx:15793 (`\@@eqncr`): a row ended by `\\` in the number column has too many columns.
2280  let_i(&T_CS!("\\\\"), &T_CS!("\\lx@eqnarray@newline"), None);
2281  Ok(())
2282}
2283
2284/// The eqnarray's columns: Perl's three (latex_constructs.pool.ltxml:2231-2236), right, centre and left, math in
2285/// `\displaystyle`, and latex.ltx's fourth (:15764, `\hb@xt@\z@\bgroup\hss##\egroup`), the equation number's, in
2286/// text. A row ended by `\cr` may fill it (1804.05059: `&\cr`); `rearrange_eqnarray` drops it where empty. The math
2287/// columns keep latex.ltx's braces, `$\displaystyle{##}$` (:15760-15763; tex.web §789), as `\lx@template@bgroup`/
2288/// `\lx@template@egroup` (tex_box.rs): a cell whose `{`/`}` balance only across them (`G_t(h)=}\det(h)-e^{\frac{a}{2}g_t.`,
2289/// 2207.06932, 1912.10594) is one formula, as in pdflatex; Perl's template has none (KNOWN_PERL_ERRORS #908). Guard
2290/// `perfect_kernel_batch69c::eqnarray_cell_braces_balance_across_the_template`.
2291fn eqnarray_columns() -> Vec<Cell> {
2292  let col1 = Cell {
2293    before: Some(Tokens::new(vec![
2294      T_CS!("\\hfil"),
2295      T_MATH!(),
2296      T_CS!("\\displaystyle"),
2297      T_CS!("\\lx@template@bgroup"),
2298    ])),
2299    after: Some(Tokens::new(vec![T_CS!("\\lx@template@egroup"), T_MATH!()])),
2300    empty: true,
2301    ..Cell::default()
2302  };
2303  let col2 = Cell {
2304    before: Some(Tokens::new(vec![
2305      T_CS!("\\hfil"),
2306      T_MATH!(),
2307      T_CS!("\\displaystyle"),
2308      T_CS!("\\lx@template@bgroup"),
2309    ])),
2310    after: Some(Tokens::new(vec![
2311      T_CS!("\\lx@template@egroup"),
2312      T_MATH!(),
2313      T_CS!("\\hfil"),
2314    ])),
2315    empty: true,
2316    ..Cell::default()
2317  };
2318  let col3 = Cell {
2319    before: Some(Tokens::new(vec![
2320      T_MATH!(),
2321      T_CS!("\\displaystyle"),
2322      T_CS!("\\lx@template@bgroup"),
2323    ])),
2324    after: Some(Tokens::new(vec![
2325      T_CS!("\\lx@template@egroup"),
2326      T_MATH!(),
2327      T_CS!("\\hfil"),
2328    ])),
2329    empty: true,
2330    ..Cell::default()
2331  };
2332  let number = Cell {
2333    before: Some(Tokens::new(vec![T_CS!("\\hfil")])),
2334    empty: true,
2335    ..Cell::default()
2336  };
2337  vec![col1, col2, col3, number]
2338}

2340/// [`eqnarray_bindings`] over the given columns: an eqnarray-style alignment whose rows are numbered equations,
2341/// rearranged at the end by `rearrange_eqnarray` (IEEEtrantools' `\IEEEeqnarray`, whose column specification makes
2342/// its own preamble, IEEEtrantools.sty:1996 `\@IEEEbuildpreamble`).
2343pub fn eqnarray_bindings_with_columns(columns: Vec<Cell>) -> Result<()> {
2344  let ncolumns = columns.len();
2345  install_eqnarray_alignment(columns, ncolumns)
2346}
2347
2348/// The eqnarray alignment over `columns`, of which the first `equation_columns` hold the equations
2349/// (`rearrange_eqnarray` reads those; any after are the number column's).
2350fn install_eqnarray_alignment(columns: Vec<Cell>, equation_columns: usize) -> Result<()> {
2351  // Ensure @equationgroup counter exists — it's normally created by article.cls,
2352  // but standalone classes (appolb, jpsj2, etc.) may not define it.
2353  if lookup_definition(&T_CS!("\\the@equationgroup@ID"))?.is_none() {
2354    NewCounter!("@equationgroup", "document", idprefix => "EG", idwithin => "section");
2355  }
2356  // The equation columns' count, for `rearrange_eqnarray`: a row with an extra `&` grows the alignment past the
2357  // template (`next_column`), and Perl reads the eqnarray's columns 0/1/2 whatever the rows hold.
2358  let ncolumns = equation_columns.to_string();
2359  let has_number_column = equation_columns < columns.len();
2360  let template = Template::new(TemplateConfig {
2361    columns: Some(columns),
2362    ..TemplateConfig::default()
2363  });
2364  let mut xml_attrs = HashMap::default();
2365  xml_attrs.insert(String::from("class"), String::from("ltx_eqn_eqnarray"));
2366  // Perl: colsep => LookupDimension('\arraycolsep')->multiply(2)
2367  // LookupDimension (not lookup_register) so a document that `\def`s
2368  // `\arraycolsep` into a plain macro reads its body silently, matching Perl —
2369  // `lookup_register` would emit a spurious `expected:register` warning there.
2370  let acol = lookup_dimension_cs("\\arraycolsep", false).unwrap_or_default();
2371  let colsep = acol.pt_value(None) * 2.0;
2372  if colsep > 0.0 {
2373    xml_attrs.insert(String::from("colsep"), s!("{}pt", colsep));
2374  }
2375  // Perl: my $cur_jot = LookupDimension('\jot');
2376  //   if ($cur_jot && $cur_jot->valueOf != LookupDimension('\lx@default@jot')->valueOf)
2377  //     { $attributes{rowsep} = $cur_jot; }
2378  let cur_jot = lookup_dimension_cs("\\jot", false).unwrap_or_default();
2379  if cur_jot.value_of()
2380    != lookup_dimension_cs("\\lx@default@jot", false)
2381      .unwrap_or_default()
2382      .value_of()
2383  {
2384    xml_attrs.insert(String::from("rowsep"), cur_jot.to_string());
2385  }
2386  let mut properties = SymHashMap::default();
2387  properties.insert("preserve_structure", Stored::Bool(true));
2388  // latex.ltx `\eqnarray`: `$$\halign to\displaywidth` (IEEEtrantools.sty:2013 alike).
2389  properties.insert(crate::tex_tables::ALIGNMENT_IS_DISPLAY, Stored::Bool(true));
2390  // The columns past the equations' are the number column (latex.ltx:15764), which `\lx@eqnarray@number@check`
2391  // guards.
2392  if has_number_column {
2393    properties.insert(
2394      "eqnarray_columns",
2395      Stored::Number(Number::new(equation_columns as i64)),
2396    );
2397  }
2398  // Use custom alignment hooks for equationgroup/equation/_Capture_
2399  // Perl: my %attr = RefStepID('@equationgroup') — but Perl runs it inside the
2400  // container-open hook, i.e. at ABSORB time, after ALL digestion: every
2401  // group's id gets the LAST section's prefix (S3.EGx1 for a group whose own
2402  // rows are S2.E*). Minting HERE, at digest time, keeps the group's section
2403  // prefix consistent with its rows — and makes the eager and streaming
2404  // (interleaved) pipelines agree byte-for-byte. Sanctioned divergence from
2405  // Perl, user ruling 2026-07-29: OXIDIZED_DESIGN #91.
2406  let group_id: Option<String> = ref_step_id("@equationgroup")
2407    .ok()
2408    .and_then(|props| props.get("id").map(ToString::to_string));
2409  let alignment = Alignment::new(AlignmentConfig {
2410    template: Some(template),
2411    open_container: Rc::new(move |document, mut props| {
2412      if let Some(id) = &group_id {
2413        props.insert(String::from("xml:id"), id.clone());
2414      }
2415      props.insert(String::from("class"), String::from("ltx_eqn_eqnarray"));
2416      props.insert(String::from("_ncolumns"), ncolumns.clone());
2417      if has_number_column {
2418        props.insert(String::from("_number_column"), String::from("true"));
2419      }
2420      document
2421        .open_element("ltx:equationgroup", Some(props), None)
2422        .map(Some)
2423    }),
2424    close_container: Rc::new(|document| document.close_element("ltx:equationgroup")),
2425    open_row: Rc::new(|document, mut props| {
2426      // Perl: $$row{id} and $$row{tags} are passed via props from be_absorbed.
2427      // The id was stored on the row during after_equation.
2428      if let Some(id) = props.remove("id") {
2429        props.insert(String::from("xml:id"), Stored::from(id.to_string()));
2430      }
2431      // Extract tags (Digested) before converting to string props
2432      let tags_digested = props.remove("tags");
2433      // (the next number's reference forms of a labelled unnumbered row, `NEXT_NUMBER_TAGS_PROPERTY`, which
2434      // `rearrange_eqnarray` keeps or drops)
2435      let next_number_tags = props.remove(NEXT_NUMBER_TAGS_PROPERTY);
2436      if next_number_tags.is_some() {
2437        props.insert(NEXT_NUMBER_ROW_ATTRIBUTE.to_string(), Stored::from("true"));
2438      }
2439      let str_props: HashMap<String, String> =
2440        props.into_iter().map(|(k, v)| (k, v.to_string())).collect();
2441      document.open_element("ltx:equation", Some(str_props), None)?;
2442      // If we have digested tags, absorb them into the opened element
2443      if let Some(Stored::Digested(d)) = tags_digested {
2444        document.absorb(&d, None)?;
2445      }
2446      if let Some(Stored::Digested(d)) = next_number_tags {
2447        document.absorb(&d, None)?;
2448      }
2449      Ok(())
2450    }),
2451    close_row: Rc::new(|document| document.close_element("ltx:equation")),
2452    open_column: Rc::new(|document, props| {
2453      document
2454        .open_element("ltx:_Capture_", Some(props), None)
2455        .map(Some)
2456    }),
2457    close_column: Rc::new(|document| document.close_element("ltx:_Capture_")),
2458    is_math: true,
2459    properties,
2460    xml_attributes: xml_attrs,
2461  });
2462  assign_alignment(alignment, None);
2463  // NOTE: Perl's eqnarrayBindings does NOT set Let(T_MATH, '\lx@dollar@in@mathmode').
2464  // eqnarray creates the alignment directly (not through alignmentBindings),
2465  // so the $ tokens in its template use \lx@dollar@default — same as amsRearrangeableBindings.
2466  let_i(&T_CS!("\\\\"), &T_CS!("\\lx@alignment@newline"), None);
2467  let_i(&T_CS!("\\lx@intercol"), &T_CS!("\\lx@math@intercol"), None);
2468  let_i(
2469    &T_CS!("\\lx@alignment@row@before"),
2470    &T_CS!("\\eqnarray@row@before"),
2471    None,
2472  );
2473  let_i(
2474    &T_CS!("\\lx@alignment@row@after"),
2475    &T_CS!("\\eqnarray@row@after"),
2476    None,
2477  );
2478  // Perl: Let('\lx@eqnarray@save@label', '\lx@label');
2479  // Save the canonical \lx@label (NOT the mutable \label) as
2480  // \lx@eqnarray@save@label — global so the noalign-deferred
2481  // `\lx@eqnarray@save@label{#1}` expansion still resolves if it fires AFTER
2482  // the eqnarray group pops (witness 2404.19499 align case). Saving \lx@label
2483  // (immutable canonical) rather than \label avoids the self-recursion when
2484  // this binding re-runs while \label is already \lx@eqnarray@label (nested
2485  // align/gather, 2008.13358).
2486  let_i(
2487    &T_CS!("\\lx@eqnarray@save@label"),
2488    &T_CS!("\\lx@label"),
2489    Some(Scope::Global),
2490  );
2491  // Perl: Let('\label', '\lx@eqnarray@label');
2492  // Redirect \label to the noalign version so it runs at the equation (row) level
2493  let_i(&T_CS!("\\label"), &T_CS!("\\lx@eqnarray@label"), None);
2494  Ok(())
2495}
2496
2497/// Perl: rearrangeEqnarray (latex_constructs.pool.ltxml L2356-2445)
2498/// Analyzes column patterns in eqnarray and rearranges into MathFork structures.
2499fn rearrange_eqnarray(document: &mut Document, equationgroup: &mut Node) -> Result<()> {
2500  use crate::base_xmath::{equationgroup_join_cols, equationgroup_join_rows};
2501
2502  struct EqRow {
2503    node:             Node,
2504    cols:             Vec<Node>,
2505    has_l:            bool,
2506    has_m:            bool,
2507    has_r:            bool,
2508    numbered:         bool,
2509    labelled:         bool,
2510    tagged:           bool,
2511    unnumbered_eqncr: bool,
2512    next_number:      bool,
2513    keep_next_number: bool,
2514  }
2515
2516  // Scan the equations (rows). Perl reads the eqnarray's three columns; an `\IEEEeqnarray` has as many as its
2517  // specification (`eqnarray_bindings_with_columns`, which records the template's width on the group), read the same
2518  // way: the first column (`l`), the last (`r`) and any between (`m`) — with three columns, Perl's. With fewer than
2519  // three there is no `r`: `{rl}`'s second column is the relation's (`m`).
2520  let ncols = equationgroup
2521    .get_attribute("_ncolumns")
2522    .and_then(|n| n.parse::<usize>().ok())
2523    .unwrap_or(3);
2524  let _ = equationgroup.remove_attribute("_ncolumns");
2525  // eqnarray's number column (latex.ltx:15764), which an `\IEEEeqnarray` lacks.
2526  let number_column = equationgroup.get_attribute("_number_column").is_some();
2527  let _ = equationgroup.remove_attribute("_number_column");
2528  let row_cells: Vec<(Node, Vec<Node>)> = document
2529    .findnodes("ltx:equation", Some(equationgroup))
2530    .into_iter()
2531    .map(|rownode| {
2532      let cells = document.findnodes("ltx:_Capture_", Some(&rownode));
2533      let cells = if number_column {
2534        drop_empty_number_cells(document, cells, ncols)
2535      } else {
2536        cells
2537      };
2538      (rownode, cells)
2539    })
2540    .collect();
2541  let mut rows: Vec<EqRow> = Vec::new();
2542  for (rownode, cells) in row_cells {
2543    let used = |c: &Node| c.get_first_child().is_some();
2544    let has_l = cells.first().is_some_and(used);
2545    let last_m = if ncols >= 3 { ncols - 1 } else { ncols };
2546    let has_m = cells.iter().take(last_m).skip(1).any(used);
2547    let has_r = ncols >= 3 && cells.get(ncols - 1).is_some_and(used);
2548    // (a labelled unnumbered row's tags are the next number's reference forms, `NEXT_NUMBER_ROW_ATTRIBUTE`: no number
2549    // of its own)
2550    let next_number = rownode.get_attribute(NEXT_NUMBER_ROW_ATTRIBUTE).is_some();
2551    let numbered = !next_number && !document.findnodes("ltx:tags", Some(&rownode)).is_empty();
2552    // OXIDIZED_DESIGN #54: Perl checks hasAttribute('label') (singular), but
2553    // LaTeXML only ever sets the plural 'labels' attribute (LaTeXML-common.rnc
2554    // L134) — so the author's documented "Separately numbered AND labeled? must
2555    // keep separate" safeguard below is dead code in Perl, collapsing distinctly
2556    // \label-ed continuation rows onto one number. We honor the intent (and match
2557    // pdfTeX) by reading the real 'labels' attribute. See KNOWN_PERL_ERRORS #46.
2558    let labelled = rownode.get_attribute("labels").is_some();
2559    // a row its author tagged (`… \nonumber \\ && \TCItag{27}`; the alignment's `_tagged` row, `Template::has_explicit_tags`)
2560    let tagged = rownode.get_attribute(TAGGED_ROW_ATTRIBUTE).is_some();
2561    let mut rownode = rownode;
2562    let unnumbered_eqncr = rownode
2563      .get_attribute(UNNUMBERED_EQNCR_ROW_ATTRIBUTE)
2564      .is_some();
2565    let _ = rownode.remove_attribute(UNNUMBERED_EQNCR_ROW_ATTRIBUTE);
2566    let _ = rownode.remove_attribute(NEXT_NUMBER_ROW_ATTRIBUTE);
2567    let keep_next_number = rownode
2568      .get_attribute(KEEP_NEXT_NUMBER_ROW_ATTRIBUTE)
2569      .is_some();
2570    let _ = rownode.remove_attribute(KEEP_NEXT_NUMBER_ROW_ATTRIBUTE);
2571    rows.push(EqRow {
2572      node: rownode,
2573      cols: cells,
2574      has_l,
2575      has_m,
2576      has_r,
2577      numbered,
2578      labelled,
2579      tagged,
2580      unnumbered_eqncr,
2581      next_number,
2582      keep_next_number,
2583    });
2584  }
2585  // Every `\label` names the number the next printing `\@@eqncr` prints ([`eqnarray_eqncr_numbering`]): an unnumbered
2586  // row's labels move to the next numbered row; when none follows (an eqnarray* row, a trailing `\nonumber` row) they
2587  // name the counter's next value, which no row of the group prints, and stay on their row with that value's
2588  // reference forms (`NEXT_NUMBER_TAGS_PROPERTY`; 1303.3431's appa3, 1602.03553, 2301.00760). So do they when the next
2589  // numbered row's number is no longer the one they named (`KEEP_NEXT_NUMBER_ROW_ATTRIBUTE`, IEEEtrantools'
2590  // `\IEEEyessubnumber`).
2591  let mut pending: Vec<usize> = Vec::new();
2592  let mut kept: Vec<usize> = Vec::new();
2593  for index in 0..rows.len() {
2594    if rows[index].numbered && !pending.is_empty() {
2595      let mut carried: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
2596      for from in pending.drain(..) {
2597        let row = &mut rows[from];
2598        if let Some(labels) = row.node.get_attribute("labels") {
2599          carried.push(labels);
2600        }
2601        let _ = row.node.remove_attribute("labels");
2602        row.labelled = false;
2603      }
2604      let row = &mut rows[index];
2605      if let Some(own) = row.node.get_attribute("labels") {
2606        carried.push(own);
2607      }
2608      document.set_attribute(&mut row.node, "labels", &carried.join(" "))?;
2609      row.labelled = true;
2610    } else if rows[index].unnumbered_eqncr && rows[index].labelled && !rows[index].numbered {
2611      if rows[index].keep_next_number {
2612        kept.push(index);
2613      } else {
2614        pending.push(index);
2615      }
2616    }
2617  }
2618  // The columns any row uses.
2619  let used_columns: Vec<usize> = (0..ncols)
2620    .filter(|&c| {
2621      rows.iter().any(|row| {
2622        row
2623          .cols
2624          .get(c)
2625          .is_some_and(|cell| cell.get_first_child().is_some())
2626      })
2627    })
2628    .collect();
2629
2630  // A single column used, which some row begins with a RELOP: every row joins one equation (below).
2631  let begins_with_relop = match used_columns[..] {
2632    [keepcol] => rows.iter().any(|row| {
2633      row
2634        .cols
2635        .get(keepcol)
2636        .and_then(|c| {
2637          c.get_child_elements()
2638            .into_iter()
2639            .next()
2640            .and_then(|first| first.get_attribute("role").map(|r| r == "RELOP"))
2641        })
2642        .unwrap_or(false)
2643    }),
2644    _ => false,
2645  };
2646  // A labelled row with no numbered row after it keeps its next number's reference forms and counts as numbered and
2647  // labelled — its own equation, as a separately numbered and labelled row is below, so that no number of the group
2648  // takes its label — unless every row joins one equation that prints a number of its own (a single column of
2649  // relations, below), whose number then stands. A row whose labels moved on drops them.
2650  let printed_number = rows.iter().any(|row| row.numbered);
2651  for (index, row) in rows.iter_mut().enumerate() {
2652    if !row.next_number {
2653      continue;
2654    }
2655    if (pending.contains(&index) || kept.contains(&index))
2656      && row.labelled
2657      && !(printed_number && begins_with_relop)
2658    {
2659      row.numbered = true;
2660    } else {
2661      for tags in document.findnodes("ltx:tags", Some(&row.node)) {
2662        document.safe_unlink(tags);
2663      }
2664    }
2665  }
2666
2667  // Only a single column was used
2668  if let [keepcol] = used_columns[..] {
2669    // Remove empty columns (in reverse order to preserve indices)
2670    for c in (0..ncols).rev() {
2671      if c == keepcol {
2672        continue;
2673      }
2674      for row in rows.iter() {
2675        if let Some(col) = row.cols.get(c) {
2676          document.safe_unlink(col.clone());
2677        }
2678      }
2679    }
2680    // Check if any column begins with a RELOP → join rows
2681    if begins_with_relop {
2682      let nodes: Vec<Node> = rows.into_iter().map(|r| r.node).collect();
2683      equationgroup_join_rows(document, equationgroup, nodes)?;
2684    } else {
2685      // Each row its own equation, except an empty numbered row under an unnumbered one, which joins it with its
2686      // number and labels, as below (`\label{e} … \nonumber\\ \end{eqnarray}`: the end's `\@@eqncr` prints it, and
2687      // the label names it; 1206.6051).
2688      let mut groups: Vec<(Vec<Node>, bool)> = Vec::new();
2689      for row in rows {
2690        let empty = !(row.has_l || row.has_m || row.has_r || row.tagged);
2691        match groups.last_mut() {
2692          Some((group, numbered)) if empty && row.numbered && !*numbered => {
2693            group.push(row.node);
2694            *numbered = true;
2695          },
2696          _ => groups.push((vec![row.node], row.numbered)),
2697        }
2698      }
2699      for (mut group, _) in groups {
2700        if group.len() > 1 {
2701          equationgroup_join_rows(document, equationgroup, group)?;
2702        } else if let Some(node) = group.first_mut() {
2703          equationgroup_join_cols(document, 1, node)?;
2704        }
2705      }
2706    }
2707    return Ok(());
2708  }
2709
2710  // Several columns used — analyze continuation patterns
2711  let mut eqs: Vec<Vec<Node>> = Vec::new();
2712  let mut numbered = false;
2713
2714  for row in &rows {
2715    let class;
2716    if row.has_l {
2717      class = "new";
2718    } else if row.has_m {
2719      if eqs.is_empty() {
2720        class = "odd";
2721      } else if numbered && row.numbered {
2722        class = "new";
2723      } else {
2724        class = "continue";
2725      }
2726    } else if row.has_r {
2727      // A continuation (`&&+ 2,`) whose row prints a number of its own under a numbered equation stands as its own
2728      // equation, as a separately numbered relation row does above: latex.ltx's `\@@eqncr` prints each row's number
2729      // (:15795), and a join keeps only the last, so the first equation's number was lost and a `\label` on it named
2730      // the continuation's (1310.2253 `eqn:zg`, PDF 11, ours 12). Perl always joins these rows: its rule keeps one
2731      // separate when it is labelled too (latex_constructs.pool.ltxml:2360-2362), but tests `hasAttribute('label')`,
2732      // which is never set (OXIDIZED_DESIGN #54, KNOWN_PERL_ERRORS #46); OXIDIZED_DESIGN_DIVERGENCES #888. Repro
2733      // cross-references/eqnarray_numbered_continuation_row_keeps_its_number.
2734      if eqs.is_empty() || (numbered && row.numbered) {
2735        class = "odd";
2736      } else {
2737        class = "continue";
2738      }
2739    } else if (row.labelled || row.tagged) && row.numbered {
2740      // All columns empty, but the row holds a `\label`: when `\@@eqncr` prints its number (latex.ltx:15795, only while
2741      // `\if@eqnsw` holds — the rule is [`eqnarray_eqncr_numbering`]) the label binds to that number. Its number and label
2742      // join the equation above, or stand as their own when that one has a number already (Perl
2743      // latex_constructs.pool.ltxml:2366-2369 notes the rows lost; 1011.4399, hep-th9412215, 1305.3072; repro
2744      // alignment/eqnarray_empty_labelled_row_keeps_number). The labels of an unnumbered row move to the next numbered row
2745      // (`rearrange_eqnarray`); a label with no numbered row after it stays, its row numbered by the next number's
2746      // reference forms (`NEXT_NUMBER_TAGS_PROPERTY`), so an empty one is an equation of its own here. So does a row whose only
2747      // content is its author's tag: Scientific Word's `… \nonumber \\ && \TCItag{27}` numbers the equation above it
2748      // (pdflatex prints (27) on the tag's row; nlin0106009's 11 such rows; OXIDIZED_DESIGN_DIVERGENCES #591,
2749      // KNOWN_PERL_ERRORS #682) — in a multi-column eqnarray; a single-column one returned above, where the tagged row
2750      // stands as its own equation. An auto-numbered empty row (`\\ \\`) is removed, as in Perl.
2751      class = if eqs.is_empty() || numbered {
2752        "new"
2753      } else {
2754        "continue"
2755      };
2756    } else if row.numbered && !eqs.is_empty() && !numbered {
2757      // All columns empty, numbered, under an unnumbered equation: the number `\@@eqncr` prints on a row of its own,
2758      // after rows ended by `\cr` (`x &=& y \cr \end{eqnarray}`; `… \cr &&\\`, 0708.0012, nucl-th9807024) or
2759      // `\nonumber`. It is that equation's, so it joins it with its tags and id (latex.ltx:15789-15797; repro
2760      // cross-references/eqnarray_cr_then_empty_numbered_row). Perl removes the row and the number with it.
2761      class = "continue";
2762    } else {
2763      // All columns empty
2764      class = "remove";
2765    }
2766
2767    if class == "remove" {
2768      document.safe_unlink(row.node.clone());
2769    } else if class == "new" || class == "odd" {
2770      numbered = row.numbered;
2771      eqs.push(vec![row.node.clone()]);
2772    } else {
2773      // "continue"
2774      numbered |= row.numbered;
2775      if let Some(last) = eqs.last_mut() {
2776        last.push(row.node.clone());
2777      }
2778    }
2779  }
2780
2781  // Now rearrange
2782  for eqset in eqs {
2783    equationgroup_join_rows(document, equationgroup, eqset)?;
2784  }
2785  Ok(())
2786}
2787
2788/// eqnarray numbering as latex.ltx's `\@@eqncr` state (latex.ltx:15750-15797). A row is numbered only if it ends
2789/// through `\@@eqncr` (`\\`, `\\*`, `\\[len]`, `\end{eqnarray}`; here `\lx@eqnarray@number@check`) and no `\nonumber`
2790/// came since the previous `\@@eqncr`: `\nonumber` is `\global\@eqnswfalse`, `\@@eqncr` prints `\@eqnnum` and steps the
2791/// counter only `\if@eqnsw`, then sets it true, and a row ended by a raw `\cr` neither prints nor resets it. So a
2792/// `\nonumber` in a `\cr` row unnumbers the next row too (2112.13115), and a `\cr` row is unnumbered (1011.0523,
2793/// nucl-th9903062). `\@currentlabel` is `\p@equation\theequation`, the counter `\eqnarray`'s `\stepcounter` and each
2794/// printing `\@@eqncr` step, so every `\label` names the number the next printing `\@@eqncr` prints: the labels of an
2795/// unnumbered row move to the next numbered row in `rearrange_eqnarray` (`UNNUMBERED_EQNCR_ROW_ATTRIBUTE`; a `\label`
2796/// in a `\nonumber` row, 1206.6051's NA3; in a `\cr` row, 0708.0012), and stay where they are when none follows, with
2797/// the counter's next value's reference forms ([`eqnarray_next_number_tags`]; 1303.3431's `appa3`, 1602.03553). A
2798/// number `\@@eqncr` prints on an empty row of its own under an unnumbered one (`x &=& y \cr \end{eqnarray}`,
2799/// `\cr &&\\`, `\nonumber\\ \end{eqnarray}`) is that equation's (`NUMBER_ROW_PROPERTY`; 0708.0012, nucl-th9807024,
2800/// 1206.6051). For the environments that opt in with `eqncr=1`: latex.ltx's eqnarray and eqnarray*. Rust-only (Perl
2801/// numbers each row unless it holds `\nonumber`: OXIDIZED_DESIGN_DIVERGENCES #847). Witnesses also 0806.3762,
2802/// 0910.0753. Guards `perfect_kernel_batch78n::{eqnarray_row_ended_by_cr_is_unnumbered,
2803/// eqnarray_empty_numbered_row_numbers_the_equation_above, eqnarray_cr_row_label_names_next_number,
2804/// eqnarray_nonumber_row_label_names_next_number, eqnarray_nonumber_holds_until_eqncr}`,
2805/// `perfect_kernel_batch78r::eqnarray_label_with_no_numbered_row_after_it_names_the_next_number`.
2806pub(crate) fn eqnarray_eqncr_numbering() -> bool {
2807  with_value(
2808    "EQUATION_NUMBERING",
2809    |v| matches!(v, Some(Stored::HashStored(n)) if matches!(n.get("eqncr"), Some(&Stored::Bool(true)))),
2810  )
2811}
2812
2813/// latex.ltx's `\if@eqnsw` ([`eqnarray_eqncr_numbering`]), global as there.
2814pub(crate) const EQNARRAY_EQNSW: &str = "EQNARRAY_EQNSW";
2815
2816/// The value `\if@eqnsw` takes where an eqnarray begins and after each `\@@eqncr`: true in latex.ltx (:15754, :15795
2817/// `\global\@eqnswtrue`); equations.sty's `\if@defeqnsw`, false in its eqnarray* (contrib equations_sty.rs;
2818/// hep-ph9904268). Local; absent is true.
2819const EQNARRAY_DEFAULT_EQNSW: &str = "EQNARRAY_DEFAULT_EQNSW";
2820
2821/// The `\if@eqnsw` an eqnarray row starts with ([`EQNARRAY_DEFAULT_EQNSW`]).
2822pub(crate) fn eqnarray_default_eqnsw() -> bool {
2823  !matches!(
2824    lookup_value(EQNARRAY_DEFAULT_EQNSW),
2825    Some(Stored::Bool(false))
2826  )
2827}
2828
2829/// Sets, locally, the `\if@eqnsw` the eqnarray rows start with: equations.sty's `\if@defeqnsw` (its eqnarray*'s
2830/// `\@defeqnswfalse`, equations.sty:128-160), read where an eqnarray begins. Witness hep-ph9904268.
2831pub fn set_eqnarray_default_eqnsw(numbered: bool) {
2832  assign_value(
2833    EQNARRAY_DEFAULT_EQNSW,
2834    Stored::Bool(numbered),
2835    Some(Scope::Local),
2836  );
2837}
2838
2839/// `\global\@eqnswtrue` from the document (equations.sty's `\yesnumber`): the eqnarray row being read is numbered by
2840/// the `\@@eqncr` that ends it (`eqnarray_eqncr_numbering`). Witness hep-ph9904268.
2841pub fn set_eqnarray_eqnsw(numbered: bool) {
2842  assign_value(EQNARRAY_EQNSW, Stored::Bool(numbered), Some(Scope::Global));
2843}

2866/// it (`\@IEEEyessubnumber`, :1410-1424), and a retraction of the row restores it. Set by `\eqnarray@row@before@`

2870/// The row tag (`EQUATIONROW_TAGS`) marking an IEEEeqnarray row whose counters are its number, no pre-advance:

2872/// and a row given its number by [`EQUATIONROW_CARRY`]. Its retraction (a `\nonumber` or `\IEEEnonumber` after them,
2873/// `\global\@eqnswfalse`, the last one wins) leaves the counters where they are and carries the number to the next row:
2874/// `\IEEEyessubnumber\nonumber \\ c &=& d`, pdflatex "(1c)" on the second row; `\IEEEyessubnumber\IEEEnonumber`
2875/// after "(4)", pdflatex "(4a)" on the row after, where this port printed "(4)" again. Witness 2012.02697
2876/// (`lcmpc.tex:123-136`, `eq:fpar`/`eq:par` 14a/14b as the `.aux`).
2877pub const EQUATIONROW_HOLDS: &str = "holds_its_counters";

2881/// [`EQUATIONROW_HOLDS`] row. Read and removed by `\eqnarray@row@before@` (sect07.rs), cleared where an equation
2882/// group's numbering begins (`\@equationgroup@numbering`), as `\@IEEEeqnarray` pre-advances afresh (:1985-1987).
2883pub const EQUATIONROW_CARRY: &str = "EQUATIONROW_CARRY";

2885/// The row attribute marking a labelled row left unnumbered whose label keeps the number it named
2886/// ([`NEXT_NUMBER_TAGS_PROPERTY`]) though a numbered row follows: that row's number is no longer the one the label named
2887/// (an `\IEEEyessubnumber` backed it out, [`keep_pending_next_numbers`]). Read and removed by `rearrange_eqnarray`.
2888pub(crate) const KEEP_NEXT_NUMBER_ROW_ATTRIBUTE: &str = "_keep_next_number";
2889
2890/// Marks the labelled rows left unnumbered since the last numbered row of the current alignment as keeping the number
2891/// their labels named (`KEEP_NEXT_NUMBER_ROW_ATTRIBUTE`), for a row whose number changes from the one they named:
2892/// IEEEtrantools' `\label` writes `\@currentlabel` as it is then, the pre-advanced number (`p6`: `c &=& d
2893/// \label{z1}\IEEEnonumber \\ e &=& f \IEEEyessubnumber`, pdflatex "2" and "1a"; 2012.02697).
2894pub fn keep_pending_next_numbers() {
2895  if let Some(alignment_digested) = lookup_alignment()
2896    && let Some(alignment_cell) = alignment_digested.alignment_cell()
2897  {
2898    let mut alignment = alignment_cell.borrow_mut();
2899    let earlier = alignment.rows().len().saturating_sub(1);
2900    for row in alignment.rows_mut().iter_mut().take(earlier).rev() {
2901      if row.is_pseudo() {
2902        continue;
2903      }
2904      if row.properties.contains_key("tags") {
2905        break;
2906      }
2907      if row.properties.contains_key(NEXT_NUMBER_TAGS_PROPERTY) {
2908        row.properties.insert(
2909          KEEP_NEXT_NUMBER_ROW_ATTRIBUTE.to_string(),
2910          Stored::from("true"),
2911        );
2912      }
2913    }
2914  }
2915}

2917/// The row attribute marking the tags of a row as its [`NEXT_NUMBER_TAGS_PROPERTY`] (not a number of its own); read and
2918/// removed by `rearrange_eqnarray`.
2919pub(crate) const NEXT_NUMBER_ROW_ATTRIBUTE: &str = "_next_number";
2920
2921/// The reference forms of the number a `\label` in an eqnarray row names (latex.ltx:15750-15752 `\stepcounter{equation}`
2922/// and `\def\@currentlabel{\p@equation\theequation}`, stepped again by each printing `\@@eqncr`, :15795): the counter's
2923/// value while the row is digested, which its preset number holds until the row's end retracts it. Every tag role a
2924/// reference prints (`tag_forms`), none printed on the row. Witnesses 1602.03553 (`eqn:zeta01`, PDF 5), 2301.00760
2925/// (54), 1303.3431 (`appa3`).
2926pub(crate) fn eqnarray_next_number_tags() -> Result<Digested> {
2927  let counter = with_value("EQUATION_NUMBERING", |v| match v {
2928    Some(Stored::HashStored(n)) => n.get("counter").map(ToString::to_string),
2929    _ => None,
2930  })
2931  .unwrap_or_else(|| String::from("equation"));
2932  let mut tokens = vec![T_CS!("\\lx@tags"), T_BEGIN!()];
2933  for (printed_here, form) in tag_forms(&Tokens::new(Explode!(counter)))? {
2934    if !printed_here {
2935      tokens.extend(form.unlist());
2936    }
2937  }
2938  tokens.push(T_END!());
2939  digest(Tokens::new(tokens))
2940}
2941
2942/// The trailing run of empty cells past an eqnarray row's `equation_columns` (latex.ltx's number column, :15764, and
2943/// any an extra `&` opened) is dropped, and a span reaching into it (a `\lefteqn`'s, over the empty cells after it)
2944/// ends at the equations' last column: the eqnarray's rows keep Perl's three columns unless a row writes past them.
2945/// An empty cell before a later one with content stays, so that content keeps its column (`k &=& l & & EXTRA`): each
2946/// `&` opens the next preamble column whatever the cell before holds (tex.web §791 `fin_col`). A trailing empty cell
2947/// is an empty unset box, which `fin_align` sets as it does a row that ended before it (§§800-810: a short row is set
2948/// over the boxes it has), so dropping the run leaves what TeX prints. eqnarray only (`_number_column`): an
2949/// `\IEEEeqnarray`'s cells are its specification's, kept as written.
2950fn drop_empty_number_cells(document: &mut Document, cells: Vec<Node>, ncols: usize) -> Vec<Node> {
2951  let spans: Vec<usize> = cells
2952    .iter()
2953    .map(|cell| {
2954      cell
2955        .get_attribute("colspan")
2956        .and_then(|n| n.parse::<usize>().ok())
2957        .unwrap_or(1)
2958    })
2959    .collect();
2960  let starts: Vec<usize> = spans
2961    .iter()
2962    .scan(0, |start, span| {
2963      let this = *start;
2964      *start += span;
2965      Some(this)
2966    })
2967    .collect();
2968  // The kept cells: up to the last that holds content or starts within the equation columns.
2969  let keep = (0..cells.len())
2970    .rev()
2971    .find(|&k| starts[k] < ncols || cells[k].get_first_child().is_some())
2972    .map_or(0, |k| k + 1);
2973  let mut kept = Vec::with_capacity(keep);
2974  for (k, mut cell) in cells.into_iter().enumerate() {
2975    if k >= keep {
2976      document.safe_unlink(cell);
2977      continue;
2978    }
2979    // The last kept cell's span ends where the dropped run begins: at the equations' last column.
2980    if k + 1 == keep && starts[k] < ncols && starts[k] + spans[k] > ncols {
2981      let width = ncols - starts[k];
2982      if width > 1 {
2983        let _ = cell.set_attribute("colspan", &width.to_string());
2984      } else {
2985        let _ = cell.remove_attribute("colspan");
2986      }
2987    }
2988    kept.push(cell);
2989  }
2990  kept
2991}

2993fn clean_class_name(name: &str) -> String {
2994  name
2995    .trim()
2996    .chars()
2997    .filter(|c| c.is_alphanumeric())
2998    .collect()
2999}

3001fn stored_string_list(keys: &[&str]) -> Stored {
3002  let deque: VecDeque<Stored> = keys.iter().map(|k| Stored::from(k.to_string())).collect();
3003  Stored::VecDequeStored(deque)
3004}
3005
3006fn init_savable_theorem_parameters(keys: Vec<&str>) {
3007  assign_value(
3008    "SAVABLE_THEOREM_PARAMETERS",
3009    stored_string_list(&keys),
3010    Some(Scope::Global),
3011  );
3012}

3014pub fn get_savable_keys() -> Vec<String> {
3015  match lookup_value("SAVABLE_THEOREM_PARAMETERS") {
3016    Some(Stored::VecDequeStored(keys)) => keys.iter().map(|k| k.to_string()).collect(),
3017    _ => vec![
3018      "\\thm@bodyfont".into(),
3019      "\\thm@headpunct".into(),
3020      "\\thm@styling".into(),
3021      "\\thm@headstyling".into(),
3022      "thm@swap".into(),
3023    ],
3024  }
3025}

3027pub fn set_savable_theorem_parameters(keys: Vec<&str>) {
3028  assign_value(
3029    "SAVABLE_THEOREM_PARAMETERS",
3030    stored_string_list(&keys),
3031    Some(Scope::Global),
3032  );

3034
3035pub fn save_theorem_style(name: &str, saved: Vec<(String, Stored)>) {
3036  let key = s!("THEOREM_{name}_PARAMETERS");
3037  let deque: VecDeque<Stored> = saved
3038    .into_iter()
3039    .flat_map(|(k, v)| vec![Stored::from(k), v])
3040    .collect();
3041  assign_value(&key, Stored::VecDequeStored(deque), Some(Scope::Global));
3042}
3043
3044pub fn use_theorem_style(name: &str) {
3045  let savable_keys = get_savable_keys();
3046  let params_key = s!("THEOREM_{name}_PARAMETERS");
3047  if let Some(Stored::VecDequeStored(params)) = lookup_value(&params_key) {
3048    let params_vec: Vec<Stored> = params.into_iter().collect();
3049    let mut i = 0;
3050    while i + 1 < params_vec.len() {
3051      let key = params_vec[i].to_string();
3052      let val = params_vec[i + 1].clone();
3053      if savable_keys.iter().any(|k| k == &key) {
3054        if key.starts_with('\\') {
3055          let tokens = match val {
3056            Stored::Tokens(t) => t,
3057            Stored::Bool(_) => {
3058              // bool stored for a register key — skip
3059              i += 2;
3060              continue;
3061            },
3062            // Values round-tripping through tokens — use internal cattable so
3063            // any `\lx@…` names re-tokenize as single CS (not `\lx`+`@…`).
3064            // `assembled`: the `Stored::Tokens` case is taken by the arm above,
3065            // so what reaches here is a scalar (string/number) rendering.
3066            _ => mouth::tokenize_internal(TeXString::assembled(val.to_string())),
3067          };
3068          let _ = assign_register(&key, RegisterValue::Tokens(tokens), None, vec![]);
3069        } else {
3070          assign_value(&key, val, None);
3071        }
3072      }
3073      i += 2;
3074    }
3075  }
3076}

3078/// The thm-patch hooks `\thmt@<set>@<point>` among `hooks` that are defined, in order, as source text to digest;
3079/// empty when none is (they exist once thmtools is loaded, thmtools_sty.rs).
3080fn theorem_hooks(hooks: &[(&str, &str)]) -> String {
3081  hooks
3082    .iter()
3083    .map(|(set, point)| s!("\\thmt@{set}@{point}"))
3084    .filter(|cs| has_meaning(&T_CS!(cs.as_str())))
3085    .collect()
3086}
