4680/// The state value marking a construct that sets its content in a parbox of the width it states
4681/// (`declare_panel_parbox_width`), by the construct's control sequence.
4682fn panel_parbox_key(cs: &str) -> String { s!("lx@panel@parbox@{cs}") }
4683
4684/// A binding declares a construct that states its width as its argument `arg` (`declare_panel_width`) and sets its
4685/// content in a parbox of that width — a `{minipage}`, a `\parbox`, a sub-figure — whose `\linewidth`, `\hsize`,
4686/// `\textwidth` and `\columnwidth` are that width (latex.ltx:16312-16313 `\@iiiminipage`; for a `\parbox`, Perl's
4687/// latex_constructs.pool.ltxml:4746 `\hsize=#4\textwidth\hsize\columnwidth\hsize`, where latex.ltx:16249-16253
4688/// `\@iiiparbox` sets only `\hsize` and, by `\@parboxrestore`, `\linewidth`: the widths are evaluated as we digest
4689/// the box): its content's stated widths are evaluated against it (`note_stated_widths_in`). An `\hbox`'s
4690/// (`\makebox[w]`, `\resizebox{w}{!}`) content is set at the enclosing line.
4691pub fn declare_panel_parbox_width(cs: &str, arg: usize) {
4692  declare_panel_width(cs, arg, &[], &[]);
4693  assign_value(&panel_parbox_key(cs), true, Some(Scope::Global));
4694}
4695
4696/// What a construct states its size with (`declare_panel_width`), where it was kept (`KEEP_STATED_LENGTHS`): the tokens
4697/// of its width and of its height, and whether it keeps its aspect ratio (a graphic), so that one of them alone scales
4698/// the other — an `\includegraphics[height=0.21\linewidth]`'s natural width (2209.01559 Fig 6) — and with graphicx's
4699/// `keepaspectratio` both bound it. A `{minipage}{0.48\textwidth}` or a `\resizebox{0.5\textwidth}{!}` states a
4700/// width only (a `\resizebox{!}{2cm}` none: its content's, scaled, `note_stated_widths_in`).
4701struct StatedSize {
4702  width:       Option<Tokens>,
4703  height:      Option<Tokens>,
4704  aspect:      bool,
4705  keep_within: bool,
4706  /// The width a positional argument gave the box (its digested value: the box is set at it), where the ratio of the
4707  /// real geometry to the registers' scales it (`note_stated_widths_in`).
4708  value:       Option<f64>,
4709  /// The width and the height the construct was given (a positional argument's digested value, a `width=`'s, a
4710  /// `height=`'s), which the stated tokens must give again at the registers' geometry (`note_stated_widths_in`).
4711  given:       (Option<f64>, Option<f64>),
4712  /// The construct sets its content in a parbox of its stated width (`declare_panel_parbox_width`).
4713  parbox:      bool,
4714}
4715
4716/// What `whatsit` states its size with (`StatedSize`), if its binding declared where (`declare_panel_width`). A width or
4717/// height it was given whose tokens were not kept (a box built outside the float, `\sbox` … `\usebox`) is
4718/// `Unevaluable`: what it states is unknown.
4719fn stated_size_of(whatsit: &Whatsit) -> std::result::Result<Option<StatedSize>, Unevaluable> {
4720  let cs = whatsit.get_definition().get_cs_name().into_owned();
4721  let key = panel_width_key(&cs);
4722  let Some(Stored::String(spec)) = lookup_value(&key) else {
4723    return Ok(None);
4724  };
4725  let spec = to_string(spec);
4726  let (arg, keys) = match spec.split_once(':') {
4727    Some((arg, keys)) => (arg, Some(keys)),
4728    None => (spec.as_str(), None),
4729  };
4730  let Some(index) = arg.parse::<usize>().ok().and_then(|a| a.checked_sub(1)) else {
4731    return Ok(None);
4732  };
4733  let args = whatsit.get_args();
4734  let argument = args.get(index).and_then(Option::as_ref).map(Digested::data);
4735  match keys {
4736    None => {
4737      // a positional width (`!` for none)
4738      let value = match argument {
4739        Some(DigestedData::RegisterValue(v)) => Some(v.clone().value_of() as f64),
4740        _ => None,
4741      };
4742      let tokens = match whatsit.get_property(STATED_LENGTHS).as_deref() {
4743        Some(Stored::VecDequeStored(lengths)) => match lengths.get(index) {
4744          Some(Stored::Tokens(tokens)) => Some(tokens.clone()),
4745          _ => None,
4746        },
4747        _ => None,
4748      };
4749      match tokens {
4750        Some(tokens) if tokens.to_string().trim() != "!" => Ok(Some(StatedSize {
4751          width: Some(tokens),
4752          height: None,
4753          aspect: false,
4754          keep_within: false,
4755          value,
4756          given: (value, None),
4757          parbox: lookup_bool(&panel_parbox_key(&cs)),
4758        })),
4759        Some(_) => Ok(None),
4760        // (a length given whose tokens were not kept: a box built before the float; one a binding gave and withheld,
4761        // `WITHHOLD_STATED_LENGTHS`, states none — subcaption's `\subfloat`, review rev78x4 finding 3)
4762        None if value.is_some() && !whatsit.get_property_bool(STATED_LENGTHS_WITHHELD) => {
4763          Err(Unevaluable)
4764        },
4765        None => Ok(None),
4766      }
4767    },
4768    Some(keys) => {
4769      let (widths, heights) = keys.split_once('|').unwrap_or((keys, ""));
4770      let widths: Vec<&str> = widths.split(',').collect();
4771      let heights: Vec<&str> = heights.split(',').filter(|h| !h.is_empty()).collect();
4772      let Some(DigestedData::KeyVals(kv)) = argument else {
4773        return Ok(None);
4774      };
4775      // (a width or height given and not kept: what it states is unknown)
4776      let width = kv.stated_entry(&widths);
4777      let height = kv.stated_entry(&heights);
4778      if (width.is_none() && widths.iter().any(|w| kv.has_key(w)))
4779        || (height.is_none() && heights.iter().any(|h| kv.has_key(h)))
4780      {
4781        return Err(Unevaluable);
4782      }
4783      // (the value the key gave the box)
4784      let given = |entry: Option<(&str, &Tokens)>| {
4785        entry.and_then(
4786          |(key, _)| match kv.get_value_digested(key).map(Digested::data) {
4787            Some(DigestedData::RegisterValue(v)) => Some(v.clone().value_of() as f64),
4788            _ => None,
4789          },
4790        )
4791      };
4792      Ok((width.is_some() || height.is_some()).then(|| StatedSize {
4793        width:       width.map(|(_, tokens)| tokens.clone()),
4794        height:      height.map(|(_, tokens)| tokens.clone()),
4795        aspect:      true,
4796        keep_within: kv.has_key("keepaspectratio"),
4797        value:       None,
4798        given:       (given(width), given(height)),
4799        parbox:      false,
4800      }))
4801    },
4802  }
4803}
4804
4805/// The registers a stated length is evaluated with: `\textwidth`, `\columnwidth`, `\linewidth`, `\hsize`.
4806const LINE_REGISTERS: [&str; 4] = ["\\textwidth", "\\columnwidth", "\\linewidth", "\\hsize"];
4807
4808/// A format is being built (`--init`, a dump): what the panel grid rule records of a document's lengths
4809/// (`note_setlength`, `note_length_allocated`) is not recorded, so no dump holds it.
4810fn building_a_format() -> bool {
4811  static INI_MODE: std::sync::LazyLock<bool> =
4812    std::sync::LazyLock::new(|| std::env::var_os("LATEXML_INI_MODE").is_some());
4813  *INI_MODE || crate::dump_paths::building_format()
4814}
4815
4816/// The state value in which a `\setlength` of a length register keeps what it stated (`note_setlength`), by the
4817/// register's name: the tokens of the length and the value they gave.
4818fn setlength_key(name: &str) -> String { s!("lx@panel@setlength@{name}") }
4819
4820/// The state value marking a length register the document allocated (`note_length_allocated`), by its name.
4821fn allocated_length_key(name: &str) -> String { s!("lx@panel@allocated@{name}") }
4822
4823/// A `\setlength` gave the length register `name` the `value` that `tokens` state (sect12.rs `assign_braced_length`,
4824/// calc's `\setlength`), recorded in the assignment's scope: a float's width read through the register
4825/// (`\setlength\figw{0.48\columnwidth}` … `\includegraphics[width=\figw]`) is evaluated at the class's real geometry as
4826/// that `\setlength` is there (`evaluate_stated_length`), while the register holds the value it gave. Review rev78x2
4827/// finding 1 (`q1.tex`/`q2.tex`: a register set in the preamble, in the body, in the float).
4828pub fn note_setlength(name: &str, tokens: &Tokens, value: i64) {
4829  if building_a_format() {
4830    return;
4831  }
4832  assign_value(
4833    &setlength_key(name),
4834    Stored::VecDequeStored(VecDeque::from([
4835      Stored::Tokens(tokens.clone()),
4836      Stored::Int(value),
4837    ])),
4838    None,
4839  );
4840}
4841
4842/// The document allocated the length register `cs` (`\newlength`; `\newdimen`'s `\dimendef`, `\newskip`'s `\skipdef`,
4843/// tex_registers.rs): a value no `\setlength` recorded (`\figw=0.48\columnwidth`, `\settowidth`) is one of the
4844/// registers' geometry, which a float's stated width that reads it cannot evaluate at the real one
4845/// (`evaluate_stated_length`). The kernel's and the bindings' registers (`\tabcolsep`, `\columnsep`, `\p@`) are not
4846/// the document's.
4847pub fn note_length_allocated(cs: &Token) {
4848  if building_a_format() {
4849    return;
4850  }
4851  assign_value(
4852    &allocated_length_key(&cs.with_cs_name(ToString::to_string)),
4853    true,
4854    Some(Scope::Global),
4855  );
4856}
4857
4858/// A stated length the real geometry cannot evaluate (`evaluate_stated_length`): it reads a length register the
4859/// document allocated whose value no `\setlength` recorded (or one changed since), a value of the registers' geometry;
4860/// or it cannot be read at the float's end, or does not give the box's value again there (`note_stated_widths_in`); or
4861/// a box was given a length whose tokens were not kept (`stated_size_of`). Its float's rows fall back to the line
4862/// before the rule, the geometry's included (`after_float`) — never worse than that (review rev78x2 finding 1,
4863/// rev78x3 findings 1-2).
4864struct Unevaluable;
4865
4866/// The length registers the length `tokens` state reads besides the line's (`LINE_REGISTERS`), expanded as their read
4867/// expands them (`\newcommand\w{\figw}`).
4868fn stated_length_registers(tokens: &Tokens) -> Vec<Rc<Register>> {
4869  let _quiet = IgnoreDiagnosticsScope::new();
4870  begingroup();
4871  let found = read_braced(tokens.clone(), || {
4872    let mut found = Vec::new();
4873    while let Some(token) = read_x_token(None, false, None)? {
4874      if let Some(register) = lookup_register_definition(&token)
4875        && matches!(
4876          register.register_type(),
4877          Some(RegisterType::Dimension | RegisterType::Glue)
4878        )
4879        && !LINE_REGISTERS.contains(&register.get_cs_name().as_ref())
4880      {
4881        found.push(register);
4882      }
4883    }
4884    Ok(found)
4885  })
4886  .map(|(found, _)| found)
4887  .unwrap_or_default();
4888  endgroup().ok();
4889  found
4890}
4891
4892/// Evaluate the length `tokens` state (a glue's natural width with `glue`) with the line registers at `registers`
4893/// (`LINE_REGISTERS`), in a group and a mouth of its own, as a braced length argument is read (calc's evaluator where
4894/// it is loaded, `Parameters::reparse_argument`). A length register it reads is what its `\setlength` stated, evaluated
4895/// at the same geometry (`note_setlength`); one the document allocated whose value no `\setlength` recorded makes it
4896/// `Unevaluable`. Its diagnostics were the source's when it was first read and are not reported again; one it cannot
4897/// read gives `None`.
4898fn evaluate_stated_length(
4899  tokens: &Tokens,
4900  registers: [i64; 4],
4901  glue: bool,
4902) -> std::result::Result<Option<i64>, Unevaluable> {
4903  evaluate_stated_length_at(tokens, registers, glue, 0)
4904}
4905
4906fn evaluate_stated_length_at(
4907  tokens: &Tokens,
4908  registers: [i64; 4],
4909  glue: bool,
4910  depth: usize,
4911) -> std::result::Result<Option<i64>, Unevaluable> {
4912  let mut reads = Vec::new();
4913  for register in stated_length_registers(tokens) {
4914    let name = register.get_cs_name().into_owned();
4915    let current = register.value_of(Vec::new()).map(|v| v.value_of());
4916    match lookup_value(&setlength_key(&name)) {
4917      Some(Stored::VecDequeStored(record)) => match (record.front(), record.get(1)) {
4918        (Some(Stored::Tokens(stated)), Some(Stored::Int(value)))
4919          if current == Some(*value) && depth < 4 =>
4920        {
4921          let is_glue = register.register_type() == Some(RegisterType::Glue);
4922          let value =
4923            evaluate_stated_length_at(stated, registers, is_glue, depth + 1)?.ok_or(Unevaluable)?;
4924          reads.push((register, is_glue, value));
4925        },
4926        _ => return Err(Unevaluable),
4927      },
4928      _ if lookup_bool(&allocated_length_key(&name)) => return Err(Unevaluable),
4929      _ => {},
4930    }
4931  }
4932  let _quiet = IgnoreDiagnosticsScope::new();
4933  let kind = if glue {
4934    RegisterType::Glue
4935  } else {
4936    RegisterType::Dimension
4937  };
4938  begingroup();
4939  let value = (|| {
4940    for (name, value) in LINE_REGISTERS.iter().zip(registers) {
4941      assign_register(name, Dimension::new(value).into(), None, Vec::new())?;
4942    }
4943    for (register, is_glue, value) in &reads {
4944      let value: RegisterValue = if *is_glue {
4945        Glue::new(*value).into()
4946      } else {
4947        Dimension::new(*value).into()
4948      };
4949      register.set_value(value, None, Vec::new());
4950    }
4951    let (value, _tail) = read_braced(tokens.clone(), || match braced_length_evaluator() {
4952      Some(evaluate) => Ok(evaluate(kind)?.value_of()),
4953      None if glue => Ok(read_glue()?.value_of()),
4954      None => Ok(read_dimension()?.value_of()),
4955    })?;
4956    Ok::<i64, Error>(value)
4957  })();
4958  endgroup().ok();
4959  Ok(value.ok())
4960}
4961
4962/// The line a stated width is evaluated against: the registers' values (`ours`: `\textwidth`, `\columnwidth`, the
4963/// line) and the real ones.
4964#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
4965struct PanelLineContext {
4966  ours: [i64; 4],
4967  real: [i64; 4],
4968}
4969
4970impl PanelLineContext {
4971  /// Inside a box of `ours`/`real` width (a minipage sets `\textwidth`, `\columnwidth`, `\hsize` and `\linewidth` to
4972  /// its width, latex.ltx `\@iiiminipage`).
4973  fn inside(ours: i64, real: i64) -> Self {
4974    PanelLineContext {
4975      ours: [ours; 4],
4976      real: [real; 4],
4977    }
4978  }
4979}
4980
4981/// What the real geometry adds to a box's width and height (scaled points), for `note_stated_widths`: a transformed
4982/// box's from its content's (a `\scalebox` scales it, a rotation turns its axes).
4983#[derive(Clone, Copy, Default)]
4984struct PanelDelta {
4985  width:  f64,
4986  height: f64,
4987}
4988
4989impl PanelDelta {
4990  /// Two boxes side by side: their widths add, the taller's height stands (the one the geometry changes most).
4991  fn beside(self, other: PanelDelta) -> PanelDelta {
4992    PanelDelta {
4993      width:  self.width + other.width,
4994      height: if other.height.abs() > self.height.abs() {
4995        other.height
4996      } else {
4997        self.height
4998      },
4999    }
5000  }
5001}
5002
5003/// A box's size property `key` (a `Dimension`, as its sizer or after-digest code recorded it), in scaled points.
5004fn box_dimension(whatsit: &Whatsit, key: &str) -> Option<f64> {
5005  whatsit
5006    .get_property(key)
5007    .and_then(|s| Option::<RegisterValue>::from(s.as_ref()))
5008    .map(|v| v.value_of() as f64)
5009}
5010
5011/// A box's numeric property `key` (`xscale`, `angle`, as its after-digest code recorded it).
5012fn box_number(whatsit: &Whatsit, key: &str) -> Option<f64> {
5013  whatsit
5014    .get_property(key)
5015    .and_then(|s| s.to_string().trim().parse::<f64>().ok())
5016}
5017
5018/// Inside the outermost float's group, at its end (`after_float`; its body is the box list being built, and every
5019/// macro and register the body defined is in force, review rev78x2 finding 1): every width a construct in it states
5020/// (`declare_panel_width`, kept as tokens under `KEEP_STATED_LENGTHS`) is evaluated at the registers' values and at
5021/// the real geometry (`install_panel_line`), and the box records what the real one adds (`PANEL_WIDTH_DELTA`) in the
5022/// ratio of the two — its width times `real/ours − 1`, so a width the body narrowed (`\setlength\linewidth{…}` before
5023/// `0.9\linewidth`) or a box a rotation turned scales as it does; a box's content is evaluated against its own width
5024/// (a child's `\linewidth` is its parent's evaluated width), an `\hspace`'s glue the same way (`PANEL_GLUE_DELTA`;
5025/// 2311.18531 Fig 1, `0.48 + 3×0.24\textwidth` with `−0.25\textwidth` of `\hspace` under geometry, one row of 4 in
5026/// the PDF), and a sub-float's line is its stated width at the real geometry (`{subfigure}{0.48\textwidth}`;
5027/// 2605.03152 S3.F2), or the float's real line where it kept the float's (subfigure.sty's in-line panels). A
5028/// `\scalebox` or `\resizebox` without a width of its own scales its content's (`xscale`), a rotation turns its axes
5029/// (`angle`; review rev78x2 finding 2, `q3.tex`). A box's own material is no width it states (1703.09474 Fig 13,
5030/// 2503.09651 Fig 1: `width=0.23\linewidth,height=0.23\linewidth`). Nothing is recorded, and `false` returned, when a
5031/// width cannot be evaluated (`Unevaluable`): the float's rows are set as before the rule (`after_float`). Review
5032/// rev78x findings 1, 3; rev78x3 findings 1-2.
5033fn note_stated_widths(boxes: &[Digested], geometry: &VecDeque<Stored>) -> bool {
5034  let geometry: Vec<i64> = geometry
5035    .iter()
5036    .map(|v| match v {
5037      Stored::Dimension(d) => d.value_of(),
5038      _ => 0,
5039    })
5040    .collect();
5041  let [
5042    textwidth,
5043    columnwidth,
5044    linewidth,
5045    hsize,
5046    real_text,
5047    real_column,
5048    real_line,
5049  ] = geometry[..]
5050  else {
5051    return true;
5052  };
5053  let context = PanelLineContext {
5054    ours: [textwidth, columnwidth, linewidth, hsize],
5055    real: [real_text, real_column, real_line, real_line],
5056  };
5057  let mut notes = Vec::new();
5058  for bx in boxes {
5059    if note_stated_widths_in(bx, context, &mut notes).is_err() {
5060      return false;
5061    }
5062  }
5063  for (bx, key, value) in notes {
5064    if let DigestedData::Whatsit(w) = bx.data() {
5065      w.borrow_mut().set_property(key, value);
5066    }
5067  }
5068  true
5069}
5070
5071/// How far (scaled points) a stated length evaluated again at the registers' geometry may be from the value it gave
5072/// the box (`note_stated_widths_in`): the rounding of a value written out and read back (a graphic's `width=`).
5073const STATED_LENGTH_TOLERANCE: f64 = 4.0;
5074
5075/// The properties `note_stated_widths` sets, once every width in the float is evaluated.
5076type PanelNotes = Vec<(Digested, &'static str, Stored)>;
5077
5078fn note_stated_widths_in(
5079  bx: &Digested,
5080  context: PanelLineContext,
5081  notes: &mut PanelNotes,
5082) -> std::result::Result<PanelDelta, Unevaluable> {
5083  let note = |notes: &mut PanelNotes, key: &'static str, value: f64| {
5084    notes.push((
5085      bx.clone(),
5086      key,
5087      Stored::Dimension(Dimension::new(value.round() as i64)),
5088    ));
5089  };
5090  let ratio = |ours: i64, real: i64| {
5091    if ours != 0 {
5092      real as f64 / ours as f64
5093    } else {
5094      1.0
5095    }
5096  };
5097  let w = match bx.data() {
5098    DigestedData::List(_) => {
5099      let mut delta = PanelDelta::default();
5100      for item in bx.unlist() {
5101        let inner = note_stated_widths_in(&item, context, notes)?;
5102        delta = delta.beside(inner);
5103      }
5104      return Ok(delta);
5105    },
5106    DigestedData::Whatsit(w) => w,
5107    _ => return Ok(PanelDelta::default()),
5108  };
5109  // A caption is no panel and sets none (`arrange_panels` ends a row at it): the widths its text states stand as they
5110  // are, so a box it cannot read again leaves the float's panels evaluated (1307.6961 A2.F8: isotope.sty's
5111  // `\makebox[\@tempdimb]` of a `\settowidth` in a group that has ended, in the caption of three `\resizebox{11.3cm}`
5112  // panels on AASTeX 5's 469.755pt page).
5113  if matches!(
5114    w.borrow().get_definition().get_cs_name().as_ref(),
5115    "\\lx@@caption" | "\\@@toccaption"
5116  ) {
5117    return Ok(PanelDelta::default());
5118  }
5119  let (stated, glue) = {
5120    let w = w.borrow();
5121    (stated_size_of(&w)?, w.has_property(PANEL_GLUE_DELTA))
5122  };
5123  // A stated length evaluated at the registers' geometry and at the real one. Either one it cannot read (a macro
5124  // defined in a group that has ended, `{\def\w{0.48\columnwidth}…}`), or one that does not give again the value the
5125  // box was given (`given`: a macro the float redefined since, an outer `\def\w` an inner one shadowed), is
5126  // `Unevaluable` (review rev78x3 finding 1, `p1.tex` F1-F2, `p8.tex` F1).
5127  let evaluate = |tokens: &Tokens,
5128                  inside: PanelLineContext,
5129                  is_glue: bool,
5130                  given: Option<f64>|
5131   -> std::result::Result<(i64, i64), Unevaluable> {
5132    let ours = evaluate_stated_length(tokens, inside.ours, is_glue)?.ok_or(Unevaluable)?;
5133    let real = evaluate_stated_length(tokens, inside.real, is_glue)?.ok_or(Unevaluable)?;
5134    match given {
5135      Some(given) if (ours as f64 - given).abs() > STATED_LENGTH_TOLERANCE => Err(Unevaluable),
5136      _ => Ok((ours, real)),
5137    }
5138  };
5139  // An `\hspace` between panels (`\lx@panel@hskip`): its glue, at the real geometry.
5140  if glue {
5141    if let Some(StatedSize { width: Some(tokens), given, .. }) = stated {
5142      let width = box_dimension(&w.borrow(), "width");
5143      let (ours, real) = evaluate(&tokens, context, true, given.0.or(width))?;
5144      note(
5145        notes,
5146        PANEL_GLUE_DELTA,
5147        width.unwrap_or(ours as f64) * (ratio(ours, real) - 1.0),
5148      );
5149    }
5150    return Ok(PanelDelta::default());
5151  }
5152  let mut inner = context;
5153  let mut own: Option<PanelDelta> = None;
5154  let mut stated_width = false;
5155  if let Some(stated) = stated {
5156    let width = match &stated.width {
5157      Some(tokens) => Some(evaluate(tokens, context, false, stated.given.0)?),
5158      None => None,
5159    };
5160    let height = match &stated.height {
5161      Some(tokens) => Some(evaluate(tokens, context, false, stated.given.1)?),
5162      None => None,
5163    };
5164    // The box as it was sized at the registers' geometry: the width its argument gave it, or a graphic's box (its
5165    // rotation included).
5166    let box_width = stated.value.unwrap_or_else(|| {
5167      bx.get_width(None)
5168        .ok()
5169        .flatten()
5170        .map(|v| v.value_of() as f64)
5171        .unwrap_or(0.0)
5172    });
5173    // How much the real geometry scales the box across and down.
5174    let scale = match (width, height) {
5175      // graphicx's `keepaspectratio`: the larger box within both, bound by the height where the width did not
5176      // reach its stated value
5177      (Some((wo, wr)), Some((ho, hr))) if stated.keep_within => {
5178        let across = if box_width + 65536.0 < wo as f64 {
5179          ratio(ho, hr).min(wr as f64 / box_width.max(1.0))
5180        } else {
5181          ratio(wo, wr).min(ratio(ho, hr))
5182        };
5183        Some((across, across))
5184      },
5185      (Some((wo, wr)), Some((ho, hr))) => Some((ratio(wo, wr), ratio(ho, hr))),
5186      (Some((wo, wr)), None) if stated.aspect => Some((ratio(wo, wr), ratio(wo, wr))),
5187      (Some((wo, wr)), None) => Some((ratio(wo, wr), 1.0)),
5188      (None, Some((ho, hr))) if stated.aspect => Some((ratio(ho, hr), ratio(ho, hr))),
5189      _ => None,
5190    };
5191    if let Some((across, down)) = scale {
5192      // (its height and depth, for a rotation round it, where the geometry scales them: a graphic's)
5193      let box_height = if down == 1.0 {
5194        0.0
5195      } else {
5196        let explicit = {
5197          let w = w.borrow();
5198          box_dimension(&w, "height").zip(box_dimension(&w, "depth"))
5199        };
5200        match explicit {
5201          Some((height, depth)) => height + depth,
5202          None => bx
5203            .compute_size(SymHashMap::default())
5204            .map(|(_, height, depth)| (height.value_of() + depth.value_of()) as f64)
5205            .unwrap_or(0.0),
5206        }
5207      };
5208      let delta = PanelDelta {
5209        width:  box_width * (across - 1.0),
5210        height: box_height * (down - 1.0),
5211      };
5212      note(notes, PANEL_WIDTH_DELTA, delta.width);
5213      own = Some(delta);
5214    }
5215    // (and a parbox's panels are set against its own width at the real geometry: a `{minipage}{\textwidth}` of
5216    // sub-figures, 2504.07193 Fig 5; an `\hbox`'s content is set at the enclosing line, `declare_panel_parbox_width`)
5217    if let Some((ours, real)) = width {
5218      note(notes, PANEL_LINE, real as f64);
5219      if stated.parbox {
5220        inner = PanelLineContext::inside(ours, real);
5221      }
5222      stated_width = true;
5223    }
5224  }
5225  // A sub-float (its `after_float` recorded its `\hsize`): its line is its stated width at the real geometry, or the
5226  // float's real line where it kept the float's (subfigure.sty's in-line panels, whose content is evaluated as the
5227  // float's: 1902.04580 Figs 15-16, `0.45\textwidth` graphics in `\subfigure`s of an mnras column).
5228  let (args, body, floatwidth, xscale, yscale, angle) = {
5229    let w = w.borrow();
5230    (
5231      w.get_args().to_vec(),
5232      w.get_body().ok().flatten(),
5233      w.get_property("floatwidth")
5234        .and_then(|s| Option::<RegisterValue>::from(s.as_ref()))
5235        .map(|r| r.value_of()),
5236      box_number(&w, "xscale"),
5237      box_number(&w, "yscale"),
5238      box_number(&w, "angle"),
5239    )
5240  };
5241  if let Some(hsize) = floatwidth
5242    && !stated_width
5243    && hsize == context.ours[3]
5244  {
5245    note(notes, PANEL_LINE, context.real[3] as f64);
5246  }
5247  let mut content = PanelDelta::default();
5248  for arg in args.iter().flatten().chain(body.as_ref()) {
5249    let delta = note_stated_widths_in(arg, inner, notes)?;
5250    content = content.beside(delta);
5251  }
5252  if let Some(own) = own {
5253    return Ok(own);
5254  }
5255  // A transformed box of no stated width of its own: its content's, scaled (`\scalebox`, `\reflectbox`) or turned.
5256  let mut delta = content;
5257  if xscale.is_some() || yscale.is_some() {
5258    let xs = xscale.unwrap_or(1.0).abs();
5259    let ys = yscale.or(xscale).unwrap_or(1.0).abs();
5260    delta = PanelDelta {
5261      width:  content.width * xs,
5262      height: content.height * ys,
5263    };
5264  }
5265  if let Some(angle) = angle {
5266    let (s, c) = angle.to_radians().sin_cos();
5267    delta = PanelDelta {
5268      width:  c.abs() * delta.width + s.abs() * delta.height,
5269      height: s.abs() * delta.width + c.abs() * delta.height,
5270    };
5271  }
5272  if (xscale.is_some() || yscale.is_some() || angle.is_some()) && delta.width != 0.0 {
5273    note(notes, PANEL_WIDTH_DELTA, delta.width);
5274  }
5275  Ok(delta)
5276}
5277
5278/// A caption's pending state, which `\@@add@caption@counters` (sect09) stores globally for its float's
5279/// `after_float` to take: `<captype>_tags`, `_id` and `_inlist` (Perl RescueCaptionCounters,
5280/// latex_constructs.pool.ltxml:3203-3214).
5281const PENDING_CAPTION_PARTS: [&str; 3] = ["tags", "id", "inlist"];
5282/// The float's own group keeps the enclosing float's pending caption state here while it is open.
5283const OUTER_PENDING_CAPTION: &str = "lx@float@outer@caption";
5284
5285/// A float that begins inside a captioned float — a `[H]` table in a minipage in a table, a
5286/// tabularray table in a table, a `\captionof` inside a float — sets the enclosing float's pending
5287/// caption state aside, for the enclosing float's type (`\@captype`) and its own, so its own caption
5288/// neither overwrites it nor hands it to the wrong float; `after_float` puts it back. Perl keeps the
5289/// one global slot per type (latex_constructs.pool.ltxml:3193-3201, afterFloat :3384-3392): the inner
5290/// float takes the outer caption's number and the outer float is left untagged, its `\label` unbound
5291/// (KNOWN_PERL_ERRORS #395). Always assigned, in the float's group, so a float nested deeper never
5292/// restores an enclosing float's state. Witness 2605.26653 (a caption-less `[H]` table in a
5293/// minipage of a captioned table: its `\label` named no table). Guard
5294/// `perfect_kernel_batch57::nested_float_keeps_the_outer_caption`.
5295fn set_aside_pending_caption(float_type: &str) {
5296  let enclosing = has_meaning(&T_CS!("\\@captype"))
5297    .then(|| do_expand(T_CS!("\\@captype")).ok())
5298    .flatten()
5299    .map(|captype| captype.to_string());
5300  let mut outer = stored_map!();
5301  for captype in enclosing.iter().map(String::as_str).chain([float_type]) {
5302    for part in PENDING_CAPTION_PARTS {
5303      let key = pin(s!("{captype}_{part}"));
5304      if let Some(pending) = remove_value_sym(key) {
5305        outer.0.insert(key, pending);
5306      }
5307    }
5308  }
5309  assign_value(
5310    OUTER_PENDING_CAPTION,
5311    Stored::HashStored(outer),
5312    Some(Scope::Local),
5313  );
5314}
5315
5316/// `after_float` of the float `set_aside_pending_caption` began: the enclosing float's pending
5317/// caption state is back, for that float's own `after_float`.
5318fn restore_pending_caption() {
5319  if let Some(Stored::HashStored(outer)) = remove_value(OUTER_PENDING_CAPTION) {
5320    for (key, pending) in outer {
5321      assign_value_sym(key, pending, Some(Scope::Global));
5322    }
5323  }
5324}
5325
5326/// The pending caption states the boxes open in a float set aside (`begin_caption_box`), innermost last.
5327const BOX_OUTER_PENDING_CAPTIONS: &str = "lx@box@outer@captions";
5328/// How many boxes were open when the float began (`begin_float`).
5329const BOX_DEPTH_AT_FLOAT: &str = "lx@float@box@depth";
5330
5331fn caption_box_depth() -> usize {
5332  match lookup_value(BOX_OUTER_PENDING_CAPTIONS) {
5333    Some(Stored::VecDequeStored(stack)) => stack.len(),
5334    _ => 0,
5335  }
5336}
5337
5338/// `after_float`: a box begun in the float whose end an error recovery skipped (a minipage closed by `\end{figure}`)
5339/// gives back the state it set aside, where no later caption has set its own.
5340fn unwind_caption_boxes() {
5341  let depth = match lookup_value(BOX_DEPTH_AT_FLOAT) {
5342    Some(Stored::Number(Number(depth))) => depth.max(0) as usize,
5343    _ => return,
5344  };
5345  while caption_box_depth() > depth {
5346    let _ = pop_value(BOX_CAPTION_COUNTS);
5347    if let Ok(Some(Stored::HashStored(outer))) = pop_value(BOX_OUTER_PENDING_CAPTIONS) {
5348      for (key, pending) in outer {
5349        if with(key, lookup_value).is_none() {
5350          assign_value_sym(key, pending, Some(Scope::Global));
5351        }
5352      }
5353    } else {
5354      break;
5355    }
5356  }
5357}
5358
5359/// The float type a box (`{minipage}`, `\parbox`) begun in a float captions for: `\@captype`, inside a float.
5360fn caption_box_type() -> Option<String> {
5361  (lookup_bool("lx@in@float") && has_meaning(&T_CS!("\\@captype")))
5362    .then(|| do_expand(T_CS!("\\@captype")).ok())
5363    .flatten()
5364    .map(|captype| captype.to_string().trim().to_string())
5365    .filter(|captype| !captype.is_empty())
5366}
5367
5368/// A box (`{minipage}`, `\parbox`) begun in a float sets the float's pending caption state aside, so that a caption
5369/// in the box is the box's own: the box is a group (latex.ltx `\@iiiminipage`, `\@iiiparbox`), and the
5370/// `\@currentlabel` that `\caption`'s `\refstepcounter` sets in it — what a `\label` after it names — ends with it.
5371/// Two captioned minipages side by side in a figure are two numbered figures, each `\ref` its own number; the float
5372/// took the last caption's counters and every `\label` in it (Perl's `insertBlock` captures the box into an id-less
5373/// block that `floatToLabel` climbs past, TeX_Box.pool.ltxml:449-519, Document.pm:1098-1127), so each `\ref` read
5374/// the last number. `end_caption_box` hands the box what its captions left, and gives the float its state back.
5375pub fn begin_caption_box() -> Result<()> {
5376  let mut outer = stored_map!();
5377  let mut counts = stored_map!();
5378  if let Some(captype) = caption_box_type() {
5379    for captype in caption_box_types(&captype) {
5380      for part in PENDING_CAPTION_PARTS {
5381        let key = pin(s!("{captype}_{part}"));
5382        if let Some(pending) = remove_value_sym(key) {
5383          outer.0.insert(key, pending);
5384        }
5385      }
5386      let count = s!("{CAPTION_COUNT_PREFIX}{captype}");
5387      counts
5388        .0
5389        .insert(pin(&count), Stored::Number(Number(lookup_int(&count))));
5390    }
5391  }
5392  push_value(BOX_CAPTION_COUNTS, Stored::HashStored(counts))?;
5393  push_value(BOX_OUTER_PENDING_CAPTIONS, Stored::HashStored(outer))
5394}
5395
5396/// The prefix of the state key counting the captions made of a type (`\@@add@caption@counters`, sect09.rs).
5397pub(crate) const CAPTION_COUNT_PREFIX: &str = "lx@caption@count@";
5398/// The caption counts as each open box (`begin_caption_box`) began, innermost last.
5399const BOX_CAPTION_COUNTS: &str = "lx@box@caption@counts";
5400
5401/// The caption types a box begun in a float of `captype` may hold its own caption of: the float's, and its sub-type,
5402/// which subcaption's `\subcaption` captions in (`\caption` under `\@captype` `sub<type>`, subcaption.sty:251): the
5403/// minipage holding it is the sub-float, as a `{subfigure}` is (subcaption.sty:97-108 makes `{subfigure}` that
5404/// minipage). Inside a sub-float the type is the sub-type already.
5405fn caption_box_types(captype: &str) -> Vec<String> {
5406  if captype.starts_with("sub") {
5407    vec![captype.to_string()]
5408  } else {
5409    vec![captype.to_string(), s!("sub{captype}")]
5410  }
5411}
5412
5413/// The end of a box `begin_caption_box` began: the counters a caption in it stepped become the box's properties
5414/// `caption_tags`, `caption_id`, `caption_inlist` and `caption_type` (`insert_block_in_paragraph` makes the box that
5415/// caption's float panel), and the float's pending caption state is back.
5416pub fn end_caption_box(whatsit: &mut Whatsit) -> Result<()> {
5417  // A box in math (a minipage in an `array` cell) leaves its caption to the float, as before: the ids made in math
5418  // are the math's own, and the float's must exist when they are made.
5419  let in_math = lookup_bool("IN_MATH");
5420  let counts = match pop_value(BOX_CAPTION_COUNTS)? {
5421    Some(Stored::HashStored(counts)) => counts,
5422    _ => stored_map!(),
5423  };
5424  // A box with two sub-captions (2008.05644: two `\includegraphics` + `\subcaption` pairs in one minipage) is not one
5425  // sub-figure: its captions stay its float's, as before.
5426  let made_one = |captype: &str| {
5427    let count = s!("{CAPTION_COUNT_PREFIX}{captype}");
5428    let before = match counts.0.get(&pin(&count)) {
5429      Some(Stored::Number(Number(n))) => *n,
5430      _ => 0,
5431    };
5432    lookup_int(&count) - before == 1
5433  };
5434  if let Some(captype) = caption_box_type().and_then(|captype| {
5435    let types = caption_box_types(&captype);
5436    let main = types.first().cloned();
5437    types.into_iter().find(|captype| {
5438      lookup_value(&s!("{captype}_id")).is_some()
5439        && (Some(captype) == main.as_ref() || made_one(captype))
5440    })
5441  }) && !in_math
5442  {
5443    for part in PENDING_CAPTION_PARTS {
5444      if let Some(pending) = remove_value(&s!("{captype}_{part}")) {
5445        whatsit.set_property(&s!("caption_{part}"), pending);
5446      }
5447    }
5448    whatsit.set_property("caption_type", Stored::String(pin(&captype)));
5449  }
5450  if let Some(Stored::HashStored(outer)) = pop_value(BOX_OUTER_PENDING_CAPTIONS)? {
5451    for (key, pending) in outer {
5452      if !(in_math && with(key, lookup_value).is_some()) {
5453        assign_value_sym(key, pending, Some(Scope::Global));
5454      }
5455    }
5456  }
5457  Ok(())
5458}
5459
5460/// A sub-float's first opener in its float steps the float's own counter ahead of its caption
5461/// (Perl beforeFloat `preincrement`): once per float — not when the last float to close was of this
5462/// sub-type (`LAST_FLOATTYPE`, set by `after_float`) or the float's caption is done.
5463pub fn preincrement_float_counter(float_type: &str, main_counter: &str) {
5464  let last_type = lookup_value("LAST_FLOATTYPE")
5465    .map(|s| s.to_string())
5466    .unwrap_or_default();
5467  let done_caption = if_condition(&T_CS!("\\iflx@donecaption"))
5468    .unwrap_or(None)
5469    .unwrap_or(false);
5470  if float_type != last_type
5471    && !done_caption
5472    && let Ok(props) = step_float_counter(main_counter)
5473  {
5474    let prekey = s!("PREINCREMENTED_{main_counter}");
5475    assign_value(&prekey, props, Some(Scope::Global));
5476  }
5477}
5478/// Perl: afterFloat (latex_constructs.pool.ltxml L3440-3448)
5479/// Rescues caption counters into the whatsit properties.
5480/// A sectioning unit in a float's body (an `ltx:inline-sectional-block`, OXIDIZED_DESIGN_DIVERGENCES #189) steps the
5481/// section counters the float's id is made within (`idwithin => "section"`), and the float's caption, which comes
5482/// after it, would make the id in the unit's context: a `\section` in the first figure of section 1 gave the figure
5483/// `S2.F1`. The float's id is fixed first, in its own context, once per float, and its caption takes it
5484/// (`\@@add@caption@counters`); the caption still numbers the float, so a figure numbered within sections
5485/// reads its section as pdflatex prints it. Repro sectioning-frontmatter/sections_inside_floats_keep_number_id_and_ref.
5486pub fn pin_float_id_before_its_sectioning() -> Result<()> {
5487  if !lookup_bool("lx@in@float") {
5488    return Ok(());
5489  }
5490  let captype = do_expand(T_CS!("\\@captype"))?.to_string();
5491  let key = s!("lx@float@pinned@id@{captype}");
5492  // Nothing to fix when the float already has its id: its caption ran (`\iflx@donecaption`), or a sub-float stepped
5493  // its counter first (`PREINCREMENTED_<captype>`, which the caption takes, made in the float's own context).
5494  if captype.is_empty()
5495    || has_value(&key)
5496    || has_value(&s!("PREINCREMENTED_{captype}"))
5497    || if_condition(&T_CS!("\\iflx@donecaption"))
5498      .unwrap_or(None)
5499      .unwrap_or(false)
5500  {
5501    return Ok(());
5502  }
5503  // The id the caption's step would make now: `\the<counter>@ID` with `\@<counter>@ID` at the counter's next value
5504  // (`step_counter`), in a group, so neither the counter nor the definition moves.
5505  let counter = lookup_mapping("counter_for_type", &captype)
5506    .map(|c| c.to_string())
5507    .unwrap_or_else(|| captype.clone());
5508  // A float type with no counter has no numbered id to fix.
5509  if lookup_register(&s!("\\c@{counter}"), Vec::new())
5510    .ok()
5511    .flatten()
5512    .is_none()
5513  {
5514    return Ok(());
5515  }
5516  let next = counter_value(&counter)?.value_of() + 1;
5517  bgroup();
5518  def_macro(
5519    T_CS!(s!("\\@{counter}@ID")),
5520    None,
5521    Tokens::new(Explode!(next)),
5522    None,
5523  )?;
5524  let id = digest_literal(T_CS!(s!("\\the{counter}@ID")));
5525  egroup()?;
5526  assign_value(
5527    &key,
5528    Stored::String(pin(clean_id(&id?.to_string()))),
5529    Some(Scope::Global),
5530  );
5531  Ok(())
5532}
5533
5534pub fn after_float(whatsit: &mut Whatsit) {
5535  unwind_caption_boxes();
5536  let captype = digest(T_CS!("\\@captype"))
5537    .map(|d| d.to_string())
5538    .unwrap_or_default();
5539  remove_value(&s!("lx@float@pinned@id@{captype}"));
5540  // Perl: AssignValue('PREINCREMENTED_' . $type => undef, 'global');
5541  let prekey = s!("PREINCREMENTED_{captype}");
5542  remove_value(&prekey);
5543  // Perl L3389: $whatsit->setProperty(floatwidth => LookupRegister('\hsize'));
5544  // Capture \hsize as it stands at the END of the float's digestion (its
5545  // column/textwidth). `arrange_panels` reads this back from the box in the
5546  // afterClose hook to size the per-row layout — NOT the ambient \hsize at
5547  // construction time, which may have been restored to an unrelated value.
5548  let hsize = lookup_register("\\hsize", Vec::new()).ok().flatten();
5549  if let Some(hsize) = hsize.clone() {
5550    whatsit.set_property("floatwidth", Stored::from(hsize));
5551  }
5552  // The real line its panels are set in rows against (`install_panel_line`), the float's own when it is not inside
5553  // another, once the widths its body states are evaluated at the real geometry — here, in the float's group, its body
5554  // the box list being built (`note_stated_widths`; a sub-float's line with them). A width that cannot be evaluated
5555  // there, or an `\hsize` its binding set (a wrapfigure's), leaves the float the registers' line.
5556  if let Some(Stored::Dimension(line)) = lookup_value(PANEL_LINE)
5557    && lookup_value(PANEL_LINE_FRAME) == lookup_value("lx@float@frame")
5558    && matches!(lookup_value(PANEL_LINE_HSIZE), Some(Stored::Dimension(begun))
5559      if hsize.as_ref().is_some_and(|h| h.clone().value_of() == begun.value_of()))
5560  {
5561    let evaluated = match lookup_value(PANEL_GEOMETRY) {
5562      Some(Stored::VecDequeStored(geometry)) => {
5563        let body = with_box_list(<[Digested]>::to_vec);
5564        note_stated_widths(&body, &geometry)
5565      },
5566      _ => true,
5567    };
5568    if evaluated {
5569      whatsit.set_property(PANEL_LINE, Stored::Dimension(line));
5570    }
5571  }
5572  // A float whose panels' widths are the real ones without an evaluation: in a float that set its line
5573  // (`install_panel_line`, this one or the one it is in) where every register is the real geometry already
5574  // (`PANEL_GEOMETRY` unset) — a sub-float's own `\hsize`, a wrapfigure's — for the grid's markup
5575  // (`annotate_panel_grid`).
5576  if !whatsit.has_property(PANEL_LINE)
5577    && lookup_value(PANEL_LINE).is_some()
5578    && lookup_value(PANEL_GEOMETRY).is_none()
5579  {
5580    whatsit.set_property(PANEL_REGISTERS_REAL, true);
5581  }
5582  // The running-text column its line is a fraction of, where its widths are the real ones (`annotate_panel_grid`).
5583  if (whatsit.has_property(PANEL_LINE) || whatsit.get_property_bool(PANEL_REGISTERS_REAL))
5584    && let Some(Stored::Dimension(column)) = lookup_value(PANEL_COLUMN)
5585  {
5586    whatsit.set_property(PANEL_COLUMN, Stored::Dimension(column));
5587  }
5588  // A float whose rows are not set against the real line (a width it states cannot be evaluated, a float inside
5589  // another, a binding's `\hsize`) is arranged as before the rule (review rev78x3 finding 2, `p2.tex` F2-F4: four
5590  // `\figw=3.8cm` panels under `[a4paper,margin=1in]{geometry}`, one row in the PDF). Under geometry (geometry_sty /
5591  // OXIDIZED_DESIGN #99), a full-column float (its `\hsize` the class-default `\Gm@doctw`, not the live `\textwidth`,
5592  // which a minipage sets) whose page the geometry widened (`\Gm@tw`) is arranged at that width: its panels are
5593  // geometry-sized SVG pictures (their `\linewidth` raised inside the picture), so two `0.495\linewidth` boxes that
5594  // sit side by side in the PDF stay one row. Only the arrangement changes — the float's HTML content keeps the
5595  // class-default width.
5596  if !whatsit.has_property(PANEL_LINE)
5597    && let Some(hsize) = hsize
5598    && let (Ok(Some(gm_tw)), Ok(Some(doctw))) = (
5599      lookup_register("\\Gm@tw", Vec::new()),
5600      lookup_register("\\Gm@doctw", Vec::new()),
5601    )
5602  {
5603    let (h, g, d) = (hsize.value_of(), gm_tw.clone().value_of(), doctw.value_of());
5604    if h == d && g > h {
5605      whatsit.set_property(PANEL_FALLBACK_LINE, Stored::from(gm_tw));
5606    }
5607  }
5608  // A sub-float set in an `\hbox` (`note_panel_hbox`).
5609  if lookup_bool(PANEL_HBOX_BODY) {
5610    whatsit.set_property(PANEL_HBOX_BODY, true);
5611  }
5612  if let Some(Stored::String(group)) = lookup_value(PANEL_HBOX_ROW) {
5613    whatsit.set_property(PANEL_HBOX_ROW, Stored::String(group));
5614  }
5615  // A sub-float's tags — `sub<type>` of a float type (it has a list, `\ext@<type>`) — are its panel number (a
5616  // sub-caption, `\phantomcaption`, a bare `\subfloat`):
5617  // `collapse_float` keeps such a panel apart from its float.
5618  let is_sub_float = captype
5619    .strip_prefix("sub")
5620    .is_some_and(|main| has_meaning(&T_CS!(s!("\\ext@{main}"))));
5621  if is_sub_float && lookup_value(&s!("{captype}_tags")).is_some() {
5622    whatsit.set_property("panel_number", Stored::Bool(true));
5623  }
5624  rescue_caption_counters(&captype, whatsit);
5625  restore_pending_caption();
5626  assign_value(
5627    "LAST_FLOATTYPE",
5628    Stored::String(pin(&captype)),
5629    Some(Scope::Global),
5630  );
5631}
5632/// A sub-float panel's stated width is its body's, never its caption's: subfigure.sty's `\@subfloat` measures the body
5633/// (subfigure.sty:232-233 `\setbox\@tempboxa\hbox{#4}\@tempdima=\wd\@tempboxa`) and sets the sub-caption in a
5634/// `\parbox` of that width (`\@makesubfigurecaption`), where our caption is a paragraph of the column's `\hsize`
5635/// (`\lx@@caption PBoxContents`). Measured with its caption, a captioned panel took a row of its own in
5636/// `arrange_panels`: `\subfigure[]{…}` panels stacked one per row (2006.08949 Figure 2, one row in the PDF;
5637/// cond-mat9707225, astro-ph0205132, 2012.09475, 1110.0084, hep-ex0004031, 1703.00699). The panel, captioned or not
5638/// (1007.2355, OXIDIZED_DESIGN_DIVERGENCES #885), is the width of the body's material less its
5639/// `\lx@@caption`/`\@@toccaption`, its `\lx@label`s (a
5640/// `\label` makes no box, a `\write`, where the `\lx@label` whatsit was sized by its key's text, as Perl's,
5641/// Whatsit.pm:253-265 (0 wide since 79c, KNOWN_PERL_ERRORS #1144; left out here all the same): 0907.1044's
5642/// `\subfigure[…]{\label{figure:mfexampleofc2} \includegraphics…}` was 96pt wider
5643/// than its graphic) and its spaces, with the natural width of the glue it states (`\hskip`, `\hspace`, `\quad`; an
5644/// `\hfill`'s is 0; kerns are kept): the material and glue the source states, not how TeX sets the spaces round it
5645/// (FIDELITY_CHARTER §2 "Float panels"; the panel grid of SYNC_STATUS's grid-rule row counts the stated glue between
5646/// panels the same way; 1307.3388 Fig 3, guard `perfect_kernel_batch78x::a_sub_float_bodys_stated_glue_counts`). A material of no width is
5647/// measured again with its glue (1408.2843 Fig 1, a graphic whose file we did not find); only one 0 wide with its glue
5648/// too leaves the panel its box's width (`panel_width`). Perl measured the whole box
5649/// (latex_constructs.pool.ltxml:3286; OXIDIZED_DESIGN_DIVERGENCES #876). Witnesses 2511.21020 Figs 7-8, 1607.02761,
5650/// 2211.12798, 1601.02116 (a label between spaces). Guard `perfect_kernel_batch78t::subfigure_panel_is_as_wide_as_its_body`.
5651pub fn note_sub_float_body_width(whatsit: &mut Whatsit) {
5652  let Ok(Some(body)) = whatsit.get_body() else {
5653    return;
5654  };
5655  // The body's boxes, its lists (a group's) opened, less its captions, labels and (unless `with_glue`) glue; the glue it
5656  // states (`\hspace`, `\hskip`, `\quad`; an `\hfill` is 0 wide), not its spaces, adds its natural width (`stated`), as
5657  // between panels (1307.3388 Fig 3's `\subfigure[]{⏎\hspace{-0.4cm}⏎\includegraphics…}` pairs, 2+2 in the PDF;
5658  // 2008.06630 Figs 1, 7).
5659  fn material(boxes: Vec<Digested>, with_glue: bool, kept: &mut Vec<Digested>, stated: &mut i64) {
5660    for bx in boxes {
5661      match bx.data() {
5662        DigestedData::List(_) => material(bx.unlist(), with_glue, kept, stated),
5663        _ if !with_glue && is_glue(&bx) => *stated += stated_glue_width(&bx),
5664        DigestedData::Whatsit(w) => match w.borrow().get_definition().get_cs_name().as_ref() {
5665          "\\lx@@caption" | "\\@@toccaption" | "\\lx@label" => {},
5666          _ => kept.push(bx.clone()),
5667        },
5668        _ => kept.push(bx),
5669      }
5670    }
5671  }
5672  let (mut boxes, mut stated) = (Vec::new(), 0);
5673  material(body.unlist(), false, &mut boxes, &mut stated);
5674  // Nothing but the caption: the panel hosts a `\captionof` whose material is outside it (caption_sty.rs
5675  // `captionof_environment@subfigure`), and keeps the box's. An uncaptioned body is its material too: its spaces and
5676  // `\label`s count nothing (the panel grid rule; 1007.2355 Figs 1, 3: `\subfigure{⏎\includegraphics[width=0.45
5677  // \textwidth]{…}⏎\label{…}}` pairs, one row in the PDF, measured with the spaces and the label's key text).
5678  if boxes.is_empty() {
5679    return;
5680  }
5681  let font = match whatsit.get_property("font").as_deref() {
5682    Some(Stored::Font(font)) => Some(font.clone()),
5683    _ => lookup_font(),
5684  };
5685  let Some(font) = font else {
5686    return;
5687  };
5688  let measure = |boxes: &[Digested]| {
5689    let mut options = SymHashMap::default();
5690    options.insert("mode", Stored::String(pin!("restricted_horizontal")));
5691    font
5692      .compute_boxes_size(boxes, options)
5693      .ok()
5694      .map(|(width, ..)| width)
5695  };
5696  let mut width = measure(&boxes);
5697  // A material of no width — a graphic whose file we did not find (1408.2843 Fig 1: `\subfigure[]{⏎\includegraphics
5698  // {recomb.eps}}` shipping only recomb.pdf) — is measured again with its glue, the measure before the glue was left
5699  // out (int61a), so such a panel still shares its row; only a body that is 0 wide with its glue falls back to the box
5700  // (`panel_width`; 1610.06413, nlin0606018). Review rev78t5 finding 1; guard
5701  // `perfect_kernel_batch78t::subfigure_panels_of_no_known_width_share_a_row`.
5702  if width.as_ref().is_none_or(|w| w.value_of() <= 0) {
5703    let mut with_glue = Vec::new();
5704    material(body.unlist(), true, &mut with_glue, &mut 0);
5705    width = measure(&with_glue);
5706  } else if let Some(material) = width.as_mut()
5707    && material.value_of() + stated > 0
5708  {
5709    // (with the glue it states, where that leaves it a width)
5710    *material = Dimension::new(material.value_of() + stated);
5711  }
5712  if let Some(width) = width {
5713    whatsit.set_property("panel_body_width", Stored::Dimension(width));
5714  }
5715}
5716
5717/// The natural width (scaled points) of the glue `bx` the source states — `\hskip`, `\hspace`, `\quad` (`isSkip`, its
5718/// `width`; an `\hfill`'s is 0) — and 0 for a space.
5719fn stated_glue_width(bx: &Digested) -> i64 {
5720  fn width(b: &impl BoxOps) -> i64 {
5721    if b.get_property_bool("isSkip") {
5722      b.get_property("width")
5723        .and_then(|w| Option::<RegisterValue>::from(w.as_ref()))
5724        .map_or(0, |w| w.value_of())
5725    } else {
5726      0
5727    }
5728  }
5729  match bx.data() {
5730    DigestedData::TBox(b) => width(&*b.borrow()),
5731    DigestedData::Whatsit(w) => width(&*w.borrow()),
5732    _ => 0,
5733  }
5734}
5735
5736/// Is `bx` glue — a space, `\hskip`, `\hspace`, `\quad`, `\hfill` (`isSkip`, or `isSpace` and not a kern)?
5737fn is_glue(bx: &Digested) -> bool {
5738  fn glue(b: &impl BoxOps) -> bool {
5739    b.get_property_bool("isSkip")
5740      || (b.get_property_bool("isSpace") && !b.get_property_bool("isKern"))
5741  }
5742  match bx.data() {
5743    DigestedData::TBox(b) => glue(&*b.borrow()),
5744    DigestedData::Whatsit(w) => glue(&*w.borrow()),
5745    _ => false,
5746  }
5747}

5749/// Is `qname` a "panel break" element (Perl `figure_panel_break_names`,
5750/// L3245-3251) — a break/caption/metadata child that flushes the current row
5751/// rather than being a panel itself?
5752pub fn is_panel_break_name(qname: SymStr) -> bool {
5753  with(qname, |name| {
5754    matches!(
5755      name,
5756      "ltx:break"
5757        | "ltx:caption"
5758        | "ltx:toccaption"
5759        | "ltx:title"
5760        | "ltx:toctitle"
5761        | "ltx:subtitle"
5762        | "ltx:creator"
5763        | "ltx:contact"
5764        | "ltx:date"
5765        | "ltx:tags"
5766        | "ltx:classification"
5767        | "ltx:acknowledgements"
5768        | "ltx:resource"
5769        | "ltx:navigation"
5770    )
5771  })
5772}

5774/// Perl `%standalone_panel_names` (L3227-3229): block-level elements expected to

5776fn is_standalone_panel_name(qname: SymStr) -> bool {

5786        | "ltx:theorem"
5787        | "ltx:proof"

5796/// A sub-float panel's measured body width (scaled points; `note_sub_float_body_width`), where it has one above 0.
5797fn panel_body_width_of(document: &Document, node: &Node) -> Option<f64> {
5798  match document.get_node_box(node).as_ref().map(Digested::data) {
5799    Some(DigestedData::Whatsit(w)) => {
5800      match w.borrow().get_property("panel_body_width").as_deref() {
5801        Some(Stored::Dimension(width)) if width.value_of() > 0 => Some(width.value_of() as f64),
5802        _ => None,
5803      }
5804    },
5805    _ => None,
5806  }
5807}
5808
5809/// Width (in scaled points) of the box that produced `node`, or 0 if unknown.
5810/// Perl: `$document->getNodeBox($child)->getWidth->valueOf()`. When the node has
5811/// no tracked box width (e.g. a minipage/parbox, whose set width rides on the
5812/// element's `width` ATTRIBUTE rather than a box property in our tree), fall back
5813/// to that attribute — otherwise the panel reads as zero-width and gets spuriously
5814/// merged into its neighbour (figure_grids minipage grids).
5815fn panel_width(document: &Document, node: &Node) -> f64 {
5816  if let Some(width) = box_panel_width(node) {
5817    return width;
5818  }
5819  // A sub-float panel's body, its caption left out (`note_sub_float_body_width`). A body of no known width (0) falls
5820  // back to the box, as before the body measure: as 0 it joined every neighbour's row and, at a row's start, left the
5821  // panel list (1610.06413 Figs 2, 4, hep-ex0703011, nlin0606018).
5822  if let Some(width) = panel_body_width_of(document, node) {
5823    return width;
5824  }
5825  let node_box = document.get_node_box(node);
5826  let box_width = node_box
5827    .and_then(|b| b.get_width(None).ok().flatten())
5828    .map(|r| r.value_of() as f64)
5829    .unwrap_or(0.0);
5830  if box_width > 0.0 {
5831    return box_width;
5832  }
5833  node
5834    .get_attribute("width")
5835    .and_then(|w| Dimension::spec_to_f64(&w).ok())
5836    .unwrap_or(0.0)
5837}
5838
5839/// Width (scaled points) a `\parbox`/minipage is set at: any node carrying its class and `width` —
5840/// the box itself, or the one child it was folded into (`insert_block`, Perl TeX_Box.pool.ltxml:489-493:
5841/// `<p class="ltx_minipage" width=…>`).
5842/// TeX sets such a box as a `\vbox` whose `\hsize` is the declared width (latex.ltx:16249-16253,
5843/// 16305-16312), so a folded `ltx:p` is a panel of that width, not a paragraph on its own row:
5844/// Perl's `%standalone_panel_names` and its box-width sizing (latex_constructs.pool.ltxml:3225-3227,
5845/// 3277, 3286, 3335) stacked text minipages one per row, each at its text's natural width (KPE #310;
5846/// witnesses 2605.27134 S5.F8, 2605.17146 S4.F4). A source `\par` between rows is a row separator of its own
5847/// (`note_panel_separator`; `captions-floats/par_breaks_a_panel_row`).
5848fn box_panel_width(node: &Node) -> Option<f64> {
5849  let class = node.get_attribute("class")?;
5850  if !class
5851    .split_whitespace()
5852    .any(|c| c == "ltx_minipage" || c == "ltx_parbox")
5853  {
5854    return None;
5855  }
5856  node
5857    .get_attribute("width")
5858    .and_then(|w| Dimension::spec_to_f64(&w).ok())
5859    .filter(|w| *w > 0.0)
5860}
5861
5862/// Width (scaled points) of the sole `ltx:graphics` descendant of a figure/table
5863/// panel, or `None` unless there is exactly one. `\subcaptionbox` and subfig
5864/// `\subfloat` panels carry no explicit `{width}`, so their box is sized to the
5865/// full float `\hsize` — which hides the panel's real content width from
5866/// [`arrange_panels`] and stacks the panels one-per-row. Sizing such a panel to
5867/// its lone graphic lets siblings share a row, the way an explicit-width
5868/// `{subfigure}{0.48\linewidth}` already does (#6903). Ambiguous panels (0 or >1
5869/// graphic) return `None`, so the caller keeps the box width unchanged.
5870fn sole_graphic_width(document: &Document, node: &Node) -> Option<f64> {
5871  let qname = document::get_node_qname(node);
5872  if qname != pin!("ltx:figure") && qname != pin!("ltx:table") {
5873    return None;
5874  }
5875  let graphics_qname = pin!("ltx:graphics");
5876  let mut found: Option<Node> = None;
5877  let mut stack = node.get_child_elements();
5878  while let Some(n) = stack.pop() {
5879    if document::get_node_qname(&n) == graphics_qname {
5880      if found.is_some() {
5881        return None; // >1 graphic — don't guess which sizes the panel
5882      }
5883      found = Some(n);
5884    } else {
5885      stack.extend(n.get_child_elements());
5886    }
5887  }
5888  document
5889    .get_node_box(&found?)
5890    .and_then(|b| b.get_width(None).ok().flatten())
5891    .map(|r| r.value_of() as f64)
5892    .filter(|w| *w > 0.0)
5893}
5894
5895/// Insert a `<ltx:break class="ltx_break"/>` immediately before `child`.
5896fn insert_break_before(document: &Document, child: &mut Node) -> Result<Node> {
5897  let ns = child.get_namespace();
5898  let mut break_node = Node::new("break", ns, document.get_document())
5899    .map_err(|e| format!("could not create ltx:break node: {e:?}"))?;
5900  break_node.set_attribute("class", "ltx_break").ok();
5901  child
5902    .add_prev_sibling(&mut break_node)
5903    .map_err(|e| format!("could not insert ltx:break: {e:?}"))?;
5904  Ok(break_node)
5905}

5907/// Perl L3231: `($whatsit->getProperty('floatwidth') || Dimension('345pt'))->valueOf()`.
5908/// The float's captured `\hsize` (see `after_float`), read from the box the
5909/// afterClose hook receives; 345pt when absent. The rows' line is the real one
5910/// where `after_float` recorded it (`panel_line_of`).
5911fn float_width_of(whatsit: Option<&Digested>) -> f64 {
5912  whatsit
5913    .and_then(|w| w.get_property("floatwidth"))
5914    .and_then(|s| Option::<RegisterValue>::from(s.as_ref()))
5915    .map(|r| r.value_of() as f64)
5916    .filter(|w| *w > 0.0)
5917    .unwrap_or(345.0 * 65536.0)
5918}

5920/// The real line a float's panels are set in rows against (`install_panel_line`), when it recorded one.
5921fn panel_line_of(whatsit: Option<&Digested>) -> Option<f64> {
5922  panel_dimension_of(whatsit, PANEL_LINE)
5923}
5924
5925/// A float's positive dimension property `key` (scaled points).
5926fn panel_dimension_of(whatsit: Option<&Digested>, key: &str) -> Option<f64> {
5927  whatsit
5928    .and_then(|w| w.get_property(key))
5929    .and_then(|s| Option::<RegisterValue>::from(s.as_ref()))
5930    .map(|r| r.value_of() as f64)
5931    .filter(|w| *w > 0.0)
5932}
5933
5934/// What the real geometry adds to a panel's stated width (scaled points, `note_stated_widths`): its own construct's
5935/// (`{minipage}{0.48\columnwidth}`, `\includegraphics[width=0.48\columnwidth]`), else the sum over its contents'
5936/// outermost ones (a sub-figure's graphic). 0 where no width it states names a register whose real value differs.
5937fn panel_width_delta(document: &Document, node: &Node) -> f64 {
5938  if let Some(delta) = node
5939    .get_attribute(PANEL_DELTA_ATTRIBUTE)
5940    .and_then(|d| d.parse::<f64>().ok())
5941  {
5942    return delta;
5943  }
5944  if let Some(bx) = document.get_node_box(node)
5945    && let Some(delta) = bx.get_property(PANEL_WIDTH_DELTA)
5946    && let Some(delta) = Option::<RegisterValue>::from(delta.as_ref())
5947  {
5948    return delta.value_of() as f64;
5949  }
5950  node
5951    .get_child_elements()
5952    .iter()
5953    .map(|child| panel_width_delta(document, child))
5954    .sum()
5955}
5956
5957/// The internal attribute a minipage or `\parbox` carries what the real geometry adds to its stated width on
5958/// (`PANEL_WIDTH_DELTA`), which survives its fold into its lone child (`insert_block_as`: a `{minipage}{0.83\linewidth}`
5959/// holding one `\scalebox`, 2007.15568 Tables 2-3).
5960const PANEL_DELTA_ATTRIBUTE: &str = "_panelwidthdelta";
5961
5962/// Put a box's `PANEL_WIDTH_DELTA` (`props`) on the attributes of the element it makes (`PANEL_DELTA_ATTRIBUTE`).
5963pub(crate) fn note_panel_width_delta(
5964  props: &SymHashMap<Stored>,
5965  attr: &mut HashMap<String, String>,
5966) {
5967  if let Some(Stored::Dimension(delta)) = props.get(PANEL_WIDTH_DELTA) {
5968    attr.insert(
5969      PANEL_DELTA_ATTRIBUTE.to_string(),
5970      delta.value_of().to_string(),
5971    );
5972  }
5973}

5975/// The `\hbox` group a sub-float panel was begun in (`PANEL_HBOX_ROW`, `note_panel_hbox`).
5976fn hbox_row(document: &Document, node: &Node) -> Option<SymStr> {
5977  match document
5978    .get_node_box(node)?
5979    .get_property(PANEL_HBOX_ROW)
5980    .as_deref()
5981  {
5982    Some(Stored::String(group)) => Some(*group),
5983    _ => None,
5984  }
